fr.title: Explorer l'orient exotique
fr.description: L'un des trésors cachés de la Turquie.Son histoire unique et ses paysages a coupér le souffle,sa grande variété de plats et sa richesse multiethnique dépassent l'imagination.
fr.bodyHtml:
Itinéraire

1er Jour: Arrivée a l'aéroport d'İstanbul,rencontrez votre guide personnel et envolez-vous pour Erzurum dans l'est de la Turquie.A Erzurum,vous pourrez vous détendre dans votre hotel.

2éme Jour: Erzurum,la ville la plus mystique de l'Est.A Erzurum.nous visiterons glorius Selcukian Madrasah et d'autres lieux historiques.Avant de retourner a notre hotel.nous visiterons la chute d'eau de Muradiye.Nuit a Erzurum.

3éme Jour: En passant par l'ancienne route de la Soie,nous partirons pour Kars.A la frontiére orientale de la Turquie,nous pourrons admirer un site arménien.Nous visiterons la magnifique ville en plein air d'Ani,autrefois capitale du royaume arménien,et le musée.Aprés avoir déjeuné dans la ville,nous verrons l'église des 12 Apotres qui est actuellement utilisée comme mosquée.Nous nous dirigerons vers Dogu Beyazit le long de la frontiére et aurons une nuit mystique a la périphérie du mont Ararat.Nuit a Dogu Beyazit.

4éme Jour: Aprés le petit-déjeuner,nous visiterons le célébre Palais İshak Pasa qui a été construit il y a un ciécle.Aprés avoir traversé des montagnes volcaniques,nous arriverons a Van,ou se trouve le plus grand lac de Turquie.Aprés le déjeuner,nous prendrons un bateau pour le monastére de l'ile d'Akdamar sur le lac Van.Nuit a Van.

5éme Jour: Aujourd'hui encore,nous passerons notre journée a Van.En commençant par le chateau de Hosap,nous verrons un site archéologique des plus intéressants a Cavus Tepe,une colonie de la civilisation Urartu vieille de 2900 ans.Aprés le déjeuner,nous visiterons d'abord le chateau de Van puis les tombeaux des rois Urartu.Vıous aurez la chance de voir la plus ancienne culture artisanale traditionelle apportée par les nomades turcs.Les jeunes artists turcs recréent cette ancienne culture en tissant des tapis.Nuit a Van.

6éme Jour: Aujourd'hui,notre objectif est de voir la ville la plus mystique de Mardin.Mais d'abord sur le chemin,nous nous arreterons a l'ancienne ville de Hasan Keyf qui sera sous l'eau du Tigre dans quelques années.Nuit a Mardin.

7éme Jour: Nous visiterons Midyat,célébre pour son architecture et nous y déjeunerons.Plus tard,nous visiterons Mardin,l'une des villes les plus belles et les plus attrayantes du monde,ou nous serons le jour le plus mémorable puisque vous écouterez le Bible dans l'original langue de Jésus-Christ.Nuit a Mardin.

8éme Jour: Nous commençons notre voyage vers la Mésopotamie.Nous verrons d'abord le pont Malabadi,sur le fleuve Tigre.Aprés le déjeuner,nous marherons dans les rues de Diyarbakir et visiterons la Mosquée Ulu.Avant de retourner a notre hotel,nous visiterons l'église Orthodoxe Jacobite.Nuit a Urfa.

9éme Jour: Nous irons dans la ville biblique de Harran ou nous verrons les célébres maisons de Harran et la premiére Université İslamique.Selon l'ancien testament,Harran est l'endroit ou le prophéte Abraham et ses enfants ont passé 7 ans avant de partir pour İsrael.Marcher dans la ville d'Urfa,nous verrons le lieu de naissance du Prophéte Abraham et le bazar.Nuit a Urfa.

10éme Jour: Aprés le petit-déjeuner,nous irons a la montagne Nemrut qui serait la 8éme merveille du monde.La,nous verrons les légendaires statues de Dieux et de Déesses a 2000 m de hauteur.Nuit a Adiyaman.

11éme Jour: En quittant Adiyaman,nous verrons la merveille naturelle de la Cappadoce.Plus tard,nous verrons Uchisar,Urgup,Avanos,Zelve.Aprés le diner,nous regarderons le spectacle des derviches tourneurs,représentant le Soufisme du 13éme siécle aprés JC.Nuit en Cappadoce.

12éme Jour:Avant le petit- déjeuner,vous aurez une visite fascinante en montgolfiére et aurez la chance de voir le paysage inoubliable de la Cappadoce.Vous verrez la Cappadoce onirique,le musée en plein air de Goreme,les monastéres et les églises fondées par Saint Basile,contenant les plus belles fresques.Nuit en Cappadoce.

13éme Jour: Transfert a l'aéroport pour votre vol de retour via İstanbul.

ru.title: Исследуйте Экзотическую Восточную Турцию
ru.description: One of the hidden treasures of Turkey. It’s unique history and breathtaking landscapes, great variety of food and multi-ethnical richness are beyond imagination.
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

1st Day: Arrive at Istanbul airport, meet your personal guide and fly to Erzurum in the east of Turkey. In Erzurum you can relax in your hotel.

2nd Day: Erzurum, the most mystic city of the East. In Erzurum we will visit the glorious Selcukian Madrasah and other historical places. Before we return to our hotel, we visit the water fall of Muradiye. Overnight in Erzurum.

3rd Day: Passing the Old Silk Road we will leave for Kars. At the Eastern border of Turkey, we will be able to look at an Armenian site. We will visit the gorgeous open air city of Ani once the capital city of the Armenian Kingdom and the museum. After having lunch in the city, we will see the 12 Apostle Church which is used as a mosque at the present. We will drive to Dogu Beyazit along the border and will have a mystic night at the outskirts of Mount Ararat. Overnight in Dogu Beyazit.

4th Day: After breakfast we will visit the famous Ishak Pasa Palace which was constructed over a century years. After passing volcanic mountains we will arrive in Van, where Turkey’s largest lake is located. After lunch we will take a boat to the Monastery at Akdamar Island, in Lake Van. Overnight in Van.

5th Day: Today again we will spend our day in Van. Starting with the Castle of Hosap, we will see a most interesting archeological site at Cavus Tepe which is a 2.900 years old settlement of the Urartu Civilization. After lunch we will first visit the castle of Van and then the tombs of the Urartu Kings. You will have chance to see the oldest traditional handicraft culture brought by the Turkish nomads. Young Turkish artists recreate this old culture, weaving carpets. Overnight in Van.

6th Day: Today our target is to see the most mystic city Mardin. But first on the way we will have a stop at the ancient city of Hasan Keyf which will be under the water of River Tigris in a few years time. Overnight in Mardin.

7th Day: We will visit Midyat, famous for its architecture and we will have lunch there. Later we will visit Mardin one of the most beautiful and attractive cities in the world, where we will visit the Jacobite Christian Church. Today will be the most memorable day since you will listen to the Bible in the original language of Jesus Christ. Overnight in Mardin.

8th Day: We start our journey to Mesopotamia. First we will see the Malabadi Bridge, across the River Tigris. After lunch we will walk on the streets of Diyarbakir and will visit the Ulu Mosque.The city walls of Diyarbakir are second in length only to the Great Wall of China. Before returning to our hotel we will visit the Jacobite Orthodox Church. Overnight in Urfa.

9th Day: We will go to the Biblical City of Harran where we will see the famous Harran houses and the first Islamic University. According the Old Testament Harran is the place where Prophet Abraham and his children spent 7 years before leaving for Israel. Walking in the city Urfa, we will see Prophet Abraham’s birth place and the bazaar. Overnight in Urfa.

10th Day: After breakfast we will go to the Nemrut Mountain which is said to be the 8th wonder of the world. There we will see the legendary statues of Gods and Goddesses in 2.000m height. Overnight in Adiyaman.

11th Day: Leaving Adiyaman, we will see the natural wonder of Cappadocia. Later we will see Uchisar, Urgup, Avanos, Zelve. After dinner we watch the whirling dervishes show, representing Sufism from the 13th Century .AD. Overnight in Cappadocia.

12th Day: Before the breakfast you will have a fascinating balloon tour and have a chance to view the unforgettable scenery of Cappadoccia. You will see dreamlike Cappadocia, Goreme open air museum, monasteries and churches founded by Saint Basil, containing the most beautiful frescos. Overnight in Cappadocia.

13th Day: Transfer to the airport for your homebound flight via Istanbul.

en.description: Itinerary 1st Day: You will arrive in Istanbul, the biggest city of modern Turkey. We will welcome you and you can rest in your hotel. 2nd Day: We will have an extensive tour of Istanbul. Istanbul is the only city located in 2 continents an
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

1st Day: You will arrive in Istanbul, the biggest city of modern Turkey. We will welcome you and you can rest in your hotel.

2nd Day: We will have an extensive tour of Istanbul. Istanbul is the only city located in 2 continents and was the capital city of 3 empires. Our first visit will be to the legendary St. Sophia which was built 1.500 years ago as the first cathedral of the world. It was the biggest and last construction of The Roman Empire. Following that we will visit the famous Blue Mosque. After lunch you will visit the Topkapi Palace, the administrative center, for nearly 400 years, of the Ottoman Empire. In 1461, less than ten years after the Conquest, Fatih Mehmet ordered the construction of Topkapi Palace would be known as Dar-us Saadet, the "House of Felicity". Walk along the Byzantium Hipodrom.Overnight in Istanbul.

3rd Day: In the morning we will have a Bosphorus cruise tour and you will see the beauty of Istanbul. Later you will visit the Suleymaniye Mosque and Dolmabahce Palace you will have free time at the famous Istiklal Street. Turkish Night Show at the historical Galata Tower. Overnight in Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

4th Day: You will fly from Istanbul to Izmir Airport and after driving for 45 minutes, you will reach the spectacular ancient site of Ephesus. We will have an extensive tour of this ancient site where you will see the Hadrian’s, Trajan’s and the Domitian’s Temples, the huge Roman bath, the Celcus Library and the biggest amphitheater of Turkey. After lunch you will visit the Ephesus museum where the finds of excavations in the site are displayed. Visit the authentic Village Sirince. Overnight in Kusadasi.

5th Day: Another archeological day is waiting for you since today you will make the famous PMD Tour; our first stop will be in Priene, which is an ancient city dedicated to Goddess Athena. Later we will drive to Miletos, which was a science and cultural centre in the ancient time. After lunch we will visit Didyma which means twins in Greek for God Apollo and his twin sister Artemis. The biggest oracle temple which was dedicated to Apollo has been erected in Didyma. Watching the temple you will enjoy your lunch.Overnight in Kusadasi.

6th Day: Today you will fly from Izmir to Cappadocia and see dreamlike Cappadocia, Goreme open air museum, monasteries and churches with the most beautiful frescos inside founded by St. Basil. Overnight in Cappadocia.

7th Day: Before the breakfast you have an opportunity to take a fascinating balloon tour and have a chance to view the unforgettable view of Cappadoccia. Later we will see Uchisar, Urgup, Avanos, Zelve and the famous Underground city where early period Christians were living and hiding. Overnight in Cappadocia.

8th Day: Today our bus will drive on the historical Silk Road and will stop at the biggest Caravanserai situated on that road. After having our lunch in Konya we will visit the museum of Mevlana Rumi who was a very famous philosopher who lived in the 13th century A.D. After dinner you will see the whirling dervishes show. Overnight in Konya.

9th Day: Fly to Istanbul.Free time at two historical and famous Bazaars of the Otoman time the Grand Bazaar, which was built at the command of Fatih Sultan Mehmet. It contains 4399 shops, 2195 workshops, 497 stalls and 18 fountains.The second Bazaar is the Spice Bazaar..Farewell diner at a special Restaurant. Overnight in Istanbul.

10th Day: Home flight from Istanbul Airport.

de.title: Erkunden Sie Istanbul und Anatolien
de.description: Reiseverlauf 1. Tag: Sie erreichen Istanbul, die größte Stadt der modernen Türkei. Wir heißen Sie willkommen und Sie können sich in Ihrem Hotel ausruhen. 2. Tag: Wir werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch Istanbul machen. Istanbul ist die einzi
de.bodyHtml:
Reiseverlauf

1. Tag: Sie erreichen Istanbul, die größte Stadt der modernen Türkei. Wir heißen Sie willkommen und Sie können sich in Ihrem Hotel ausruhen.

2. Tag: Wir werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch Istanbul machen. Istanbul ist die einzige Stadt auf 2 Kontinenten und war die Hauptstadt von 3 Reichen. Unser erster Besuch ist die sagenumwobene Hagia Sophia, die vor 1.500 Jahren als erste Kathedrale der Welt erbaut wurde. Es war das größte und letzte Bauwerk des Römischen Reiches. Anschließend besuchen wir die berühmte Blaue Moschee. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen Sie den Topkapi-Palast, der fast 400 Jahre lang das Verwaltungszentrum des Osmanischen Reiches war. 1461, weniger als zehn Jahre nach der Eroberung, ordnete Fatih Mehmet den Bau des Topkapi-Palastes an, der als Dar-us Saadet, das "Haus der Glückseligkeit" bekannt werden sollte. Spazieren Sie am Byzantium Hipodrom entlang. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

3. Tag: Am Morgen werden wir eine Bosporus-Kreuzfahrttour machen und Sie werden die Schönheit von Istanbul sehen. Später besuchen Sie die Süleymaniye-Moschee und den Dolmabahce-Palast. Sie haben Freizeit in der berühmten Istiklal-Straße. Türkische Nachtshow im historischen Galataturm. Übernachtung in Istanbul. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

4. Tag: Sie fliegen von Istanbul zum Flughafen Izmir und erreichen nach einer 45-minütigen Fahrt die spektakuläre antike Stätte von Ephesus. Wir werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch diese antike Stätte machen, bei der Sie die Tempel des Hadrian, des Trajan und des Domitian, das riesige römische Bad, die Celcus-Bibliothek und das größte Amphitheater der Türkei sehen. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen Sie das Ephesus-Museum, in dem die Ausgrabungsfunde der Stätte ausgestellt sind. Besuchen Sie das authentische Dorf Sirince. Übernachtung in Kusadas.

5. Tag: Ein weiterer archäologischer Tag erwartet Sie, da Sie heute die berühmte PMD-Tour machen; Unser erster Halt wird in Priene sein, einer antiken Stadt, die der Göttin Athena gewidmet ist. Später fahren wir nach Miletos, das in der Antike ein Wissenschafts- und Kulturzentrum war. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen wir Didyma, was auf Griechisch Zwillinge für Gott Apollo und seine Zwillingsschwester Artemis bedeutet. In Didyma wurde der größte Orakeltempel errichtet, der Apollo geweiht war. Beim Beobachten des Tempels genießen Sie Ihr Mittagessen. Übernachtung in Kusadasi.

6. Tag: Heute fliegen Sie von Izmir nach Kappadokien und sehen das traumhafte Kappadokien, Göreme Freilichtmuseum, Klöster und Kirchen mit den schönsten Fresken im Inneren, gegründet von St. Basilius. Übernachtung in Kappadokien.

7. Tag: Vor dem Frühstück haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine faszinierende Ballonfahrt zu unternehmen und die unvergessliche Aussicht auf Kappadokien zu genießen. Später werden wir Uchisar, Urgup, Avanos, Zelve und die berühmte unterirdische Stadt sehen, in der die Christen der frühen Zeit lebten und sich versteckten. Übernachtung in Kappadokien.

8. Tag: Heute fährt unser Bus auf der historischen Seidenstraße und hält an der größten Karawanserei an dieser Straße. Nach unserem Mittagessen in Konya besuchen wir das Museum von Mevlana Rumi, einem sehr berühmten Philosophen, der im 13. Jahrhundert n. Chr. lebte. Nach dem Abendessen sehen Sie die Show der wirbelnden Derwische. Übernachtung in Konya.

9. Tag: Flug nach Istanbul. Freizeit an zwei historischen und berühmten Basaren der osmanischen Zeit, dem Großen Basar, der auf Befehl von Fatih Sultan Mehmet gebaut wurde. Es enthält 4399 Geschäfte, 2195 Werkstätten, 497 Stände und 18 Brunnen.Der zweite Basar ist der Gewürzbasar..Abschiedsessen in einem speziellen Restaurant. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

10. Tag: Heimflug vom Flughafen Istanbul.

tr.bodyHtml:

1. Gün: Modern Türkiye'nin en büyük şehri olan İstanbul'a varacaksınız. Sizi karşılayacağız ve otelinizde dinlenebilirsiniz. 2. Gün: Kapsamlı bir İstanbul turu yapacağız. en.title: Fascinating Balloon Tour in Cappadocia
en.description: Itinerary You will be picked up from your hotel reception in Cappadocia at 4.30am and transferred to the area where you will take your Balloon ride. After having a short breakfast, you will enjoy an hour or one and a half hour Balloon ride
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

You will be picked up from your hotel reception in Cappadocia at 4.30am and transferred to the area where you will take your Balloon ride. After having a short breakfast, you will enjoy an hour or one and a half hour Balloon ride over the beauty of valleys and the Fairy Chimneys in Cappadocia.
After landing, you will get your drink and certificate. You will be transferred back to your hotel at about 7.00am. We will give you time to rest and pick you up from your hotel at 9.00am for your full day Cappadocia Tour.You will begin your discovery of dream-like Cappadocia. First we will visit the Devrent (Imagination) Valley, where there are many rock formations eroded by time and weather to resemble animals. Next we will travel the short distance to the Zelve Open Air Museum, and see houses carved into the rocks and visit a Seljukian mosque. Next we drive to Avanos Village where you will see a pottery making demonstration using old Hittie techniques. After leaving Avanos you will see Peribaglari which are the world-famous Fairy Chimneys. Next we will have lunch in a traditional cave restaurant.  After lunch, we will visit Uchisar Rock-Castle, which is the highest point in the area, Esentepe, where you can wonder at a panoramic view of Goreme valley and then finally visit Goreme Open Air Museum where you can see frescoes, churches, and monasteries cut out of solid rock. Transfer back to your hotel.

de.title: Faszinierende Ballontour in Kappadokien
de.description: Reiseverlauf Sie werden um 4.30 Uhr von Ihrer Hotelrezeption in Kappadokien abgeholt und in das Gebiet gebracht, in dem Sie Ihre Ballonfahrt unternehmen werden. Nach einem kurzen Frühstück genießen Sie eine ein- bis eineinhalbstündige Ballo
de.bodyHtml:
Reiseverlauf

Sie werden um 4.30 Uhr von Ihrer Hotelrezeption in Kappadokien abgeholt und in das Gebiet gebracht, in dem Sie Ihre Ballonfahrt unternehmen werden. Nach einem kurzen Frühstück genießen Sie eine ein- bis eineinhalbstündige Ballonfahrt über die Schönheit der Täler und der Feenkamine in Kappadokien.
Nach der Landung erhalten Sie Ihr Getränk und Ihr Zertifikat. Gegen 7.00 Uhr werden Sie zurück zu Ihrem Hotel gebracht. Wir geben Ihnen Zeit zum Ausruhen und holen Sie um 9.00 Uhr von Ihrem Hotel für Ihre ganztägige Kappadokien-Tour ab. Sie nehmen an unserer regelmäßigen Mini-Gruppentour (max. 12 Personen in derselben Gruppe) teil und beginnen Ihre Entdeckung des traumhaften Kappadokien. Zuerst besuchen wir das Devrent (Imagination) Valley, wo es viele Felsformationen gibt, die von Zeit und Wetter erodiert sind, um Tieren zu ähneln. Als nächstes fahren wir die kurze Strecke zum Zelve Open Air Museum, sehen in die Felsen gehauene Häuser und besuchen eine seldschukische Moschee. Als nächstes fahren wir zum Dorf Avanos, wo Sie eine Töpfervorführung mit alten Hittie-Techniken sehen werden. Nachdem Sie Avanos verlassen haben, sehen Sie Peribaglari, die weltberühmten Feenkamine. Als nächstes werden wir in einem traditionellen Höhlenrestaurant zu Mittag essen. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen wir die Felsenburg Uchisar, den höchsten Punkt der Gegend, Esentepe, wo Sie einen Panoramablick auf das Göreme-Tal genießen können, und besuchen Sie schließlich das Göreme-Freilichtmuseum, wo Sie Fresken, Kirchen und Klöster aus massivem Fels gehauen. Transfer zurück zu Ihrem Hotel.

en.title: Full Day Istanbul Tour - Explore the Magnificent Old City
en.description: Grand Bazaar Topkapi Blue Mosque Hippodrome
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

After we welcome you at Istanbul port or pick you up from your hotel, you will enjoy an extensive tour of Istanbul, which has in the past been the capital city of three empires and nowadays is the only city in the world to be located in two continents, Europe and Asia.

Our first visit will be to the legendary Hagia Sophia, which was built 1,500 years ago as the first cathedral of the world. It was the biggest and last construction of The Roman Empire.

Next we will visit the famous Blue Mosque, completed in 1616.

After leaving the Blue Mosque we will explore the Hippodrome, the stadium of ancient Byzantium.

We then travel about two kilometres to where you will have free time in one of the oldest shopping places in the world, the Grand Bazaar, which was built at the command of Fatih Sultan Mehmet. Within the Grand Bazaar can be found 4,399 shops, 497 stalls, 2,195 workshops and 17 fountains.

Finally, we will visit the Topkapi Palace, which was built on the orders of Mehmet the Conqueror. Construction of the Palace began in 1461, shortly after his conquest of the city, and it served as  the administrative centre of the Ottoman Empire and seat of the Sultans until 1968.

Transfer back to the port or your hotel in Istanbul.

ru.title: Экскурсия по Стамбулу на целый день - Исследуйте Великолепный Старый город
ru.description: Grand Bazaar Topkapi Blue Mosque Hippodrome
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

После того, как мы встретим вас в порту Стамбула или заберем из вашего отеля, вы насладитесь обширной экскурсией по Стамбулу, который в прошлом был столицей трех империй и в настоящее время является единственным городом в мире, расположенным на двух континентах, Европе и Азии.

Наш первый визит будет в легендарный собор Святой Софии, который был построен 1500 лет назад как первый собор в мире. Это было самое большое и последнее сооружение Римской империи.

Далее мы посетим знаменитую Голубую мечеть, построенную в 1616 году.

Покинув Голубую мечеть, мы отправимся исследовать Ипподром, стадион древней Византии.

Затем мы проедем около двух километров до того места, где у вас будет свободное время в одном из старейших торговых мест в мире, Гранд Базаре, который был построен по приказу Фатиха Султана Мехмета. На Гранд Базаре можно найти 4399 магазинов, 497 киосков, 2195 мастерских и 17 фонтанов.

Наконец, мы посетим дворец Топкапы, который был построен по приказу Мехмеда Завоевателя. Строительство дворца началось в 1461 году, вскоре после его завоевания города, и он служил административным центром Османской империи и резиденцией султанов до 1968 года.

Трансфер обратно в порт или в ваш отель в Стамбуле.

fr.description: Grand Bazaar Topkapi Blue Mosque Hippodrome
fr.bodyHtml:
Itinéraire

Aprés vous avoir accueilli au port d'İstanbul ou etre venu vous chercher a votre hotel,vous profiterez d'une visite approfondie d'İstanbul,qui a été dans le passé la capitale de trois empires et est aujourd!hui la seule ville au monde a etre située sur deux continents,Europe et Asie.

Notre premiére visite sera a la légendaire Sainte-Sophie,qui a été construite il y a 1500 ans comme la premiére cathédral du monde.C'était la plus grande et la derniére construction de l'Empire Romain.

Ensuite,nous visiterons la célébre Mosquée Bleue,achevée en 1616.

Aprés avoir quitté la Mosquée Bleue,nous explorerons l'Hippodrome,le stade de l'ancienne Byzance.

Nous parcourons ensuite environ deux km jusqu'a l'endroit ou vous aurez du temps libre dans l'un des plus anciens lieux de shopping au monde,le grand bazar,qui a été construit sous l'ordre de Fatih Sultan Mehmet.Dans le Grand Bazar se trouvent 4399 magasins,497 échoppes,2195 ateliers et 17 fountaines.

Enfin,nous visiterons le Palais de Topkapi,qui a été construit sous les ordres de Mehmet le conquérant.La construction du Palais a commencé en 1461,peu de temps aprés sa conquete de la ville,et il a servi de centre administratif de l'Empire Ottoman et de siége des Sultans jusqu'en 1968.

tr.title: Tam Gün İstanbul
tr.description: Kapalıçarşı topkapı Sultan Ahmet Camii hipodrom
tr.bodyHtml:
Tur programı

Sizi İstanbul limanında karşıladıktan veya otelinizden aldıktan sonra, geçmişte üç imparatorluğa başkentlik yapmış, günümüzde ise dünyada iki ayrı şehirden oluşan tek şehir olan İstanbul'u kapsamlı bir şekilde gezmenin keyfine varacaksınız. kıtalar, Avrupa ve Asya. İlk ziyaretimiz 1500 yıl önce dünyanın ilk katedrali olarak inşa edilen efsanevi Ayasofya olacak. Roma İmparatorluğu'nun en büyük ve son inşasıydı. Daha sonra 1616'da tamamlanan ünlü Sultanahmet Camii'ni ziyaret edeceğiz. Sultanahmet Camii'nden ayrıldıktan sonra antik Bizans'ın stadyumu olan Hipodrom'u keşfedeceğiz. Ardından yaklaşık iki kilometre yol alarak dünyanın en eski alışveriş mekanlarından biri olan Fatih Sultan Mehmet tarafından yaptırılan Kapalıçarşı'da serbest zaman geçireceğiniz yere gidiyoruz. Kapalıçarşı içerisinde 4.399 dükkan, 497 tezgah, 2.195 atölye ve 17 çeşme bulunmaktadır. Son olarak Fatih Sultan Mehmed tarafından yaptırılan Topkapı Sarayı'nı ziyaret edeceğiz. Şehrin fethinden kısa bir süre sonra 1461 yılında inşaatına başlanan saray, 1968 yılına kadar Osmanlı İmparatorluğu'nun idari merkezi ve padişahların ikametgâhı olarak hizmet vermiştir. İstanbul'daki limana veya otelinize geri dönün.

ru.title: Экскурсия по Стамбулу на целый День - Чудесный Тур по Стамбулу
ru.description: Golden Horn The Suleymaniye Mosque Spice Bazaar
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

Мы заберем вас из порта Стамбула или из вашего отеля. Вас ждет обширная экскурсия по Стамбулу, ранее известному как Константинополь, который был столицей трех империй и сегодня является единственным городом, расположенным на двух континентах. Сначала вы отправитесь в круиз по Босфору. На берегу моря вы пройдете мимо дворца Долмабахче, дворца Чираган, крепости Румели, парков и императорских павильонов дворца Йылдыз и Ортакея.

Затем вы посетите церковь Хора, которая первоначально была построена за стенами Константинополя, к югу от Золотого Рога.

Во второй половине дня вы посетите мечеть Сулеймание, строительство которой было начато в 1558 году по приказу султана Сулеймана (Сулеймана Великолепного) и было спроектировано знаменитым Синан-пашой. Наконец, вы увидите Базар специй (построенный в 1660 году), который был (и до сих пор остается) центром торговли специями в Стамбуле.

В конце тура вас доставят обратно в порт или в ваш отель в Стамбуле.

en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

We would like to give a brief information about our route "Marmaris – Fethiye – Marmaris" during which you will find a variety of optional activities in addition to visiting rich, various and naturally wonderful Mediterranean bay during your one-week blue journey.

Starting the day with a joyous and energetic breakfast after the first night spent in Kadırga bay will show you that a blue voyage is the best way to spend holiday. Our next stop will be “Ekincik”. We also would like to remind you that you will have the chance to explore Dalyan, an antique Carian City, once we arrive at Dalyan. The trip you will take in the Dalyan channel by small boats will leave you pleasant and unforgettable memories.

Having rock graves and İztuzu beach within its boundaries, Dalyan is one of the most popular touristic resorts of Turkey for one-day visits. You will feel lost in the time while watching rock graves from afar. In addition to the opportunity to taste the famous crabs of Dalyan, you will also have the chance to see Caretta Carettas in their natural environment. You may also enjoy the pleasure of swimming in the waves of İztuzu beach which is the world's 7th best beach. Besides, you may also have a care cure prepared for yourselves from the world-famous mud bath of this region.

We think that you will have a great time and enjoy the sea and the sun on the part until Fethiye of our course to the port of Fethiye, from Ağa Port to Binlik bay and Batık Hamam bay which is called drowned hammam due to an antique hammam (Turkish bath) residues of which remained under water and the famous to the naturally wonderful waters which hosts the famous Bedri Rahmi bay.

The Yassıca islands considered among the world's unique beauties will be one of our last stops before the port of Fethiye. At this point where the calmness and the silence come to a head, you may have moments that you will remember throughout your life.

Once we arrive at Fethiye, you will come across one of the fish markets which is rare in our country. You can have the fishes you bought from the market cooked right there and create yourself an alternative dining option. Fethiye is also home to various adventurous activities. If you wish, you can do paragliding by jumping from a height of 1700 meters at the summit of Babadağ and do canyoning for relaxing your muscles and sweating off. You can also salute Ölüdeniz, one of the most impressive stops of the blue journey, during this course. You can go to Ölüdeniz by minibuses pulling away from Fethiye.

Your return trip to Marmaris will also offer you as great time as you have spent during the voyage. You will also have the chance to read any books you have put off for years while sipping tea in the bays of great beauty. In order to see with your own eyes the underwater life still non-explored, you may also benefit from scuba-diving alternatives.

Wishing you a holiday that you'll never forget and get excited while remembering every moment…

ru.title: Дерья Дениз Мармарис-Фетхие-Мармарис
ru.description: Мы хотели бы предоставить краткую информацию о нашем маршруте Мармарис – Фетхие – Мармарис", во время которого вы найдете множество дополнительных мероприятий Мы хотели бы предоставить краткую информацию о нашем маршруте Мармарис – Фетхие – Мармарис", во время которого вы найдете множество дополнительных мероприятий в дополнение к посещению богатой, разнообразной и, естественно, прекрасной Средиземноморской бухты во время вашего недельного голубого путешествия.
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

Мы хотели бы предоставить краткую информацию о нашем маршруте Мармарис – Фетхие – Мармарис", во время которого вы найдете множество дополнительных мероприятий в дополнение к посещению богатой, разнообразной и, естественно, прекрасной Средиземноморской бухты во время вашего недельного голубого путешествия.

Начните день с радостного и энергичного завтрака после первой ночи, проведенной в заливе Кадырга, и вы поймете, что путешествие в голубом море - лучший способ провести отпуск. Нашей следующей остановкой будет “Экинчик”. Мы также хотели бы напомнить вам, что у вас будет возможность исследовать Дальян, древний карийский город, как только мы прибудем в Дальян. Путешествие, которое вы совершите по каналу Дальян на небольших лодках, оставит у вас приятные и незабываемые воспоминания.

Имея в своих границах скальные могилы и пляж Изтузу, Дальян является одним из самых популярных туристических курортов Турции для однодневных посещений. Вы почувствуете себя потерянным во времени, наблюдая за каменными могилами издалека. В дополнение к возможности попробовать знаменитых крабов Дальяна, у вас также будет возможность увидеть Каретта-Каретта в их естественной среде обитания. Вы также можете насладиться удовольствием от купания в волнах пляжа Изтузу, который является 7-м лучшим пляжем в мире. Кроме того, вы также можете приготовить для себя лечебное средство из всемирно известной грязевой ванны этого региона.

Мы думаем, что вы прекрасно проведете время и насладитесь морем и солнцем со стороны до Фетхие нашего курса в порт Фетхие, от порта Ага до залива Бинлик и залива Батык Хамам, который называется утонувшим хаммамом из-за старинного хаммама (турецкой бани), остатки которого остались под водой, и знаменитого до естественно прекрасных вод, в которых находится знаменитый залив Бедри Рахми.

Острова Ясыджа, считающиеся одними из уникальных красот мира, станут одной из наших последних остановок перед портом Фетхие. В этот момент, когда спокойствие и тишина достигают апогея, у вас могут быть моменты, которые вы запомните на всю свою жизнь.

Как только мы прибудем в Фетхие, вы наткнетесь на один из рыбных рынков, что редко встречается в нашей стране. Вы можете приготовить рыбу, которую вы купили на рынке, прямо там и создать себе альтернативный вариант питания. Фетхие также является домом для различных видов активного отдыха. При желании вы можете заняться парапланеризмом, прыгнув с высоты 1700 метров на вершине Бабадага, и заняться каньонингом, чтобы расслабить мышцы и избавиться от пота. Вы также можете поприветствовать Олюдениз, одну из самых впечатляющих остановок голубого путешествия, во время этого курса. Вы можете добраться до Олюдениза на микроавтобусах, отправляющихся из Фетхие.

Ваша обратная поездка в Мармарис также подарит вам такое же прекрасное время, как и во время путешествия. У вас также будет возможность почитать любые книги, которые вы откладывали годами, потягивая чай в бухтах великой красоты. Чтобы увидеть своими глазами подводную жизнь, которая еще не исследована, вы также можете воспользоваться альтернативами подводного плавания с аквалангом.

Желаю вам праздника, который вы никогда не забудете, и радоваться, вспоминая каждое мгновение…

tr.description: İsteğe bağlı çeşitli aktiviteler bulabileceğiniz "Marmaris – Fethiye – Marmaris" rotamız hakkında kısaca bilgi vermek istiyoruz. Bir haftalık mavi yolculuğunuzda zengin, çeşitli ve doğal güzellikteki Akdeniz koylarını ziyaret etmenin yanı sıra isteğe bağlı olarak çeşitli aktiviteler bulacağınız rotamız “Marmaris – Fethiye – Marmaris” hakkında kısaca bilgi vermek istiyoruz.
tr.bodyHtml:
Tur programı

Bir haftalık mavi yolculuğunuzda zengin, çeşitli ve doğal güzellikteki Akdeniz koylarını ziyaret etmenin yanı sıra isteğe bağlı olarak çeşitli aktiviteler bulacağınız rotamız “Marmaris – Fethiye – Marmaris” hakkında kısaca bilgi vermek istiyoruz. Kadırga koyunda geçirdiğiniz ilk gecenin ardından güne keyifli ve enerjik bir kahvaltı ile başlamak, mavi yolculuğun en güzel tatil olduğunu size gösterecek. Bir sonraki durağımız “Ekincik” olacak. Dalyan'a vardığımızda antik bir Karya kenti olan Dalyan'ı keşfetme şansına sahip olacağınızı da hatırlatmak isteriz. Küçük teknelerle Dalyan kanalında yapacağınız gezi size keyifli ve unutulmaz anılar bırakacaktır. Kaya mezarları ve İztuzu plajını sınırları içinde bulunduran Dalyan, günübirlik ziyaretler için Türkiye'nin en popüler turistik beldelerinden biridir. Kaya mezarlarını uzaktan izlerken kendinizi zamanın içinde kaybolmuş hissedeceksiniz. Dalyan'ın meşhur yengeçlerini tatma imkanının yanı sıra Caretta Carettaları doğal ortamlarında görme şansına da sahip olacaksınız. Dünyanın en iyi 7. plajı olan İztuzu plajında ??dalgaların keyfini de çıkarabilirsiniz. Ayrıca bu bölgenin dünyaca ünlü çamur banyosundan kendinize bakım kürü de yaptırabilirsiniz. Fethiye limanına, Ağa Limanı'ndan Binlik koyuna ve antik bir hamamdan dolayı boğulmuş hamam olarak anılan Batık Hamam koyuna rotamızın Fethiye'ye kadar olan kısmında denizin ve güneşin tadını çıkartıp güzel vakit geçireceğinizi düşünüyoruz. (Türk hamamı) kalıntıları sular altında kalan ve doğal güzellikteki suları ile meşhur Bedri Rahmi koyuna ev sahipliği yapmaktadır. Dünyanın eşsiz güzellikleri arasında sayılan Yassıca adaları, Fethiye limanından önceki son duraklarımızdan biri olacak. Sakinliğin ve sessizliğin doruğa ulaştığı bu noktada, hayatınız boyunca unutamayacağınız anlar yaşayabilirsiniz. Fethiye'ye vardığımızda ülkemizde ender bulunan balık pazarlarından biri ile karşılaşacaksınız. Pazardan aldığınız balıkları hemen orada pişirebilir ve kendinize alternatif bir yemek seçeneği oluşturabilirsiniz. Fethiye ayrıca çeşitli maceralı aktivitelere de ev sahipliği yapmaktadır. Dilerseniz Babadağ'ın zirvesinde 1700 metre yükseklikten atlayarak yamaç paraşütü yapabilir, kaslarınızı gevşetmek ve terlemek için kanyon geçişi yapabilirsiniz. Mavi yolculuğun en etkileyici duraklarından biri olan Ölüdeniz'i de bu parkurda selamlayabilirsiniz. Ölüdeniz'e Fethiye'den hareket eden dolmuşlarla gidebilirsiniz.

Y

Marmaris'e dönüş yolculuğunuz da size yolculuk boyunca geçirdiğiniz kadar harika zaman sunacaktır. Ayrıca yıllardır ertelediğiniz tüm kitapları muhteşem güzellikteki koylarda çayınızı yudumlarken okuma şansına da sahip olacaksınız. Keşfedilmemiş sualtı yaşamını kendi gözlerinizle görmek için tüplü dalış alternatiflerinden de yararlanabilirsiniz. Unutamayacağınız, her anını hatırlarken heyecanlanacağınız bir bayram dileğiyle… ÖNE ÇIKANLAR Marmaris Sarsala Koyu Cennet Adası Domuz Adası Kumlubük Tersane Adası Kadırga Limanı Bedri Rahmi Koyu Ekincik Koyu Yassıca Adaları Dalyan Göcek Ağa Limanı Gemiler Adası Manastır Koyu Ölüdeniz Binlik Koyu Turunçpınarı Koyu Hamam Koyu Fethiye

Detaylar

Fiyat şunları içerir: *Mürettebatın servisi (3 kişi: kaptan, aşçı ve güverte görevlisi) *Haftalık düzenli bir seyir için yakıt  (yaklaşık 100-110 sm) *Türk suları için transitlog *Liman ücretleri (başlangıç, bitiş limanları) - Türkiye kıyı şeridi boyunca / özel marinalar hariç *Nevresim, iç havlu ve dış havlu (hafta ortasında bir kez değiştirilecektir) Fiyat şunları içermez: *Tam Pansiyon Konaklama / Teknede yemek. TAM PANSİYON KONAKLAMA İÇİN 2 KALİTE SUNUYORUZ. Orta 45 € / Lüks 65 € kişi başı *Teknede alınan içecekler. Herhangi bir ekstra ücret ödemeden tekneye kendi içeceklerinizi getirebilirsiniz! İnternet desteği: *Bedava internet Su Sporları Oyuncakları : *Kano / Kajak - 2 kano ... ücretsiz kullanın *Paddle Board - ücretsiz kullanım *PowerDinghy - WaterToys … isteğe bağlı Su Kayağı, Ringo ve Mini Banana …  (günde en fazla 2 saat 3 saat) Farklı alternatifler ve fiyatlar için lütfen bizden bilgi alınız.

en.title: Gulet Xanthos 3 Bodrum-Hisarönü-Bodrum
en.description: Chartering a private yacht; offers you ultimate flexibility on the itinerary... Boarding starts by 14:00 o'clock. On the first day, you will have the option to remain anchored in Bodrum Port or stay the night in a nearby bay.
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Day 1: BODRUM 
Boarding starts by 14:00 o'clock. On the first day, you will have the option to remain anchored in Bodrum Port or stay the night in a nearby bay.

Day 2: PALAMUTBUKU - INCEBURUN 
After breakfast we will start to cruise to Palamutbuku Bay early in the morning. We will anchor at Ince Burun after lunch and swimming breaks. We will stay in this lovely bay for dinner and an overnight stay.

Day 3: AKTUR - BENCIK 
After breakfast we will cruise to Aktur Bay. Then our first stop will be Bencik Bay which has a very narrow entrance but a unique view once you get inside. Bencik is located at the narrowest part of the peninsula that divides Hisaronu Gulf from the Gokova Gulf but it is located at Hisaronu side. In 550’s B.C. the Cnidus people wanted to dig a tunnel in the narrowest land piece of the peninsula between the Hisaronu Gulf and the Gokova Gulf as a defense line against the Persians. That way they would make two peninsulas one island and the defence easier. They started with diligence and put in a lot of effort, however, in the end they could not manage and the city was conquered by the Persians. Dinner and an overnight stay will be in Bencik Bay.

Day 4: EMEL SAYIN - ORHANIYE - SELIMIYE 
After breakfast, we will anchor in Emel Sayın Bay and you can enjoy a swimming stop in this lovely bay. For lunch we will dock in Orhaniye. In Orhaniye Bay, you will see the unique scenery of a natural tidal formation called 'Kız Kumu' (Maiden's Beach). There are so many myths about this reddish sand-path going from the shore to the inner parts of the sea which is suitable for walking along. On a tiny island located in the bay, you can see the wrecks of an antique castle, a sign of an ancient city. Today, our final destination will be Selimiye for dinner and an overnight stay.

Day 5: DIRSEKBUKU - BOZBURUN 
After anchoring in Dirsekbuku, we will go to Bozburun which is a small fishing town. This area was popular and suitable for sponge-diving but nowadays the people of the island are no more interested in sponge-diving as it is not financially beneficial and is dangerous. In recent years, sponge-diving has been replaced by gulet tourism and nowadays Bozburun Gulets take their place in this sector.

Day 6: DATCA - CNIDOS (CNIDUS) 
We will cruise to Datca. Food and water will be supplied to the boat from Datca Harbor. We will cruise to Cnidos for dinner and an overnight stay. Cnidos was a developed city in science, art and architecture. Cnidos was the home for Aphrodite's monument and in those times the city was famous for brothels and became popular for sailors and Arabic tradesmen. You may take a walk on the shore to see the ruins

Day 7: BLACK ISLAND – POYRAZ BAY - BODRUM 
We will start to cruise early in the morning to Karaada (Black Island). Breakfast and a swimming break will be at Poyraz Bay which is located on the southern side of the island. This is such a nice bay with its turquoise-blue waters. We will dock in Bodrum Harbor for dinner and an overnight stay. Optional is to stay in a near bay for the night and return to Bodrum harbour early in the morning.

Day 8: BODRUM 
The guests will leave the boat with precious memories by 10:30 after breakfast.

tr.title: Gulet Bodrum-Hisarönü-Bodrum
tr.description: Özel yat kiralamak; seyahat programında size en üst düzeyde esneklik sunar... Biniş saat 14:00'da başlar. İlk gün Bodrum Limanı'nda demirli kalma veya geceyi yakındaki bir koyda geçirme seçeneğiniz olacak.
tr.bodyHtml:
Tur programı

1. Gün: BODRUM Biniş saat 14:00'da başlar. İlk gün Bodrum Limanı'nda demirli kalma veya geceyi yakındaki bir koyda geçirme seçeneğiniz olacak. 2. Gün: PALAMUTBÜKÜ - İNCEBURUN Sabah kahvaltısının ardından sabah erken saatlerde Palamutbükü Koyu'na doğru yola çıkılır. Öğle yemeği ve yüzme molalarının ardından İnce Burun'a demirlenir. Akşam yemeği ve geceleme için bu şirin koyda konaklıyoruz. 3. Gün: AKTUR - BENCİK Sabah kahvaltısının ardından Aktur Koyu'na hareket edilir. Daha sonra ilk durağımız oldukça dar bir girişe sahip olan ancak içeri girince eşsiz bir manzaraya sahip olan Bencik Koyu olacak. Bencik, Hisarönü Körfezi'ni Gökova Körfezi'nden ayıran yarımadanın en dar yerinde olmakla birlikte Hisarönü tarafında yer almaktadır. 550'lerde M.Ö. Knidoslular, Perslere karşı savunma hattı olarak Hisarönü Körfezi ile Gökova Körfezi arasındaki yarımadanın en dar kara parçasına tünel kazmak istediler. Böylece iki yarımadayı bir ada haline getirip savunmayı kolaylaştıracaklardı. Özenle başlayıp çok çaba sarf ettiler, ancak sonunda başaramadılar ve şehir Persler tarafından fethedildi. Akşam yemeği ve geceleme Bencik Koyu'nda yapılır. 4. Gün: EMEL SAYIN - ORHANİYE - SELİMİYE Sabah kahvaltısının ardından Emel Sayın Koyu'na demirlenir ve bu şirin koyda yüzme molasının keyfini çıkarabilirsiniz. Öğle yemeği için Orhaniye'ye yanaşıyoruz. Orhaniye Koyu'nda 'Kız Kumu' adı verilen doğal bir gelgit oluşumunun eşsiz manzarasını göreceksiniz. Kıyıdan denizin içlerine kadar uzanan, yürüyüşe elverişli bu kırmızımsı kumlu patika hakkında pek çok efsane vardır. Koyda bulunan küçücük bir adada, antik bir şehrin simgesi olan antik bir kalenin enkazını görebilirsiniz. Bugün akşam yemeği ve geceleme için son durağımız Selimiye olacak. 5. Gün: DİRSEKBÜKÜ - BOZBURUN Dirsekbükü'ne demirledikten sonra küçük bir balıkçı kasabası olan Bozburun'a gidiyoruz. Bu bölge sünger avcılığı için popüler ve uygun bir bölgeydi ancak günümüzde ada halkı maddi açıdan karlı olmadığı ve tehlikeli olduğu için sünger avcılığı ile ilgilenmiyor. Son yıllarda süngercilik yerini gulet turizmine bırakmış ve günümüzde Bozburun Guletleri de bu sektördeki yerini almıştır. 6. Gün: DATÇA - CNIDOS (CNIDOS) Datça'ya hareket edeceğiz. Tekneye yiyecek ve su Datça Limanı'ndan sağlanacaktır. Akşam yemeği ve geceleme için Knidos'a hareket edilir. Knidos bilim, sanat ve mimaride gelişmiş bir şehirdi. Knidos, Afrodit'in anıtına ev sahipliği yapmış ve o dönemlerde genelevler ile ünlü olan kent, denizciler ve Arap tüccarlar arasında popüler olmuştur. Harabeleri görmek için kıyıda yürüyüş yapabilirsiniz. 7. Gün: KARAADA – POYRAZ KOYU – BODRUM Sabah erken saatlerde Karaada'ya (Kara Ada) doğru yola çıkılır. Adanın güneyinde yer alan Poyraz Koyu'nda kahvaltı ve yüzme molası verilecektir. Turkuaz mavisi suları ile çok güzel bir koy burası. Akşam yemeği ve geceleme için Bodrum Limanı'na demirlenir. İsteğe bağlı olarak geceyi yakın bir koyda geçirmek ve sabah erken saatlerde Bodrum limanına dönmek mümkündür. 8. Gün: BODRUM Misafirler, kahvaltının ardından saat 10:30'a kadar değerli anılarla tekneden ayrılacaklar.

ru.title: Гулет Ксантос 3 Бодрум-Хисароню-Бодрум
ru.description: Аренда частной яхты; предлагает вам максимальную гибкость в выборе маршрута... Посадка начинается в 14:00. В первый день у вас будет возможность остаться на якоре в порту Бодрума или переночевать в соседней бухте.
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

День 1: БОДРУМ 
Посадка начинается в 14:00. В первый день у вас будет возможность остаться на якоре в порту Бодрума или переночевать в соседней бухте.

День 2: ПАЛАМУТБУКУ - ИНЦЕБУРУН 
После завтрака мы отправимся в круиз в залив Паламутбуку рано утром. Мы бросим якорь в Инсе Бурун после обеда и перерывов на плавание. Мы остановимся в этой прекрасной бухте на ужин и ночлег.

День 3: АКТУР-БЕНЧИК 
После завтрака мы отправимся в круиз по заливу Актур. Затем нашей первой остановкой будет залив Бенчик, который имеет очень узкий вход, но уникальный вид, как только вы попадете внутрь. Бенчик расположен в самой узкой части полуострова, которая отделяет залив Хисароню от залива Гекова, но он расположен на стороне Хисароню. В 550-х годах до н. э. жители Книда хотели прорыть туннель в самом узком месте полуострова между заливом Хисароню и заливом Гекова в качестве линии обороны от персов. Таким образом, они сделали бы два полуострова одним островом и облегчили бы оборону. Они начали с усердием и приложили много усилий, однако в конце концов им это не удалось, и город был завоеван персами. Ужин и ночевка будут в бухте Бенчик.

День 4: ЭМЕЛЬ САЙИН - ОРХАНИЕ - СЕЛИМИЕ 
После завтрака мы бросим якорь в бухте Эмель Сайин, и вы сможете насладиться остановкой для купания в этой прекрасной бухте. На обед мы пришвартуемся в Орхании. В бухте Орхание вы увидите уникальные пейзажи естественного приливного образования под названием "Кыз Куму" (Девичий пляж). Существует так много мифов об этой красноватой песчаной дорожке, идущей от берега к внутренним частям моря, которая подходит для прогулок. На крошечном острове, расположенном в заливе, можно увидеть развалины старинного замка, признак древнего города. Сегодня нашим конечным пунктом назначения будет Селимие, где мы поужинаем и остановимся на ночь.

День 5: ДИРСЕКБУКУ - БОЗБУРУН 
Бросив якорь в Дирсекбуку, мы отправимся в Бозбурун, небольшой рыбацкий городок. Этот район был популярен и подходил для дайвинга с губками, но в настоящее время жители острова больше не интересуются дайвингом с губками, так как это не выгодно с финансовой точки зрения и опасно. В последние годы дайвинг с губками был заменен туризмом в гулете, и в настоящее время гулеты Бозбуруна занимают свое место в этом секторе.

День 6: ДАТЧА - КНИДОС (КНИДУС) 
Мы отправимся в Датчу. Еда и вода будут доставляться на лодку из гавани Датча. Мы отправимся в круиз в Книдос на ужин и ночлег. Книдос был развитым городом в области науки, искусства и архитектуры. Книдос был домом для памятника Афродите, и в те времена город славился борделями и стал популярным среди моряков и арабских торговцев. Вы можете прогуляться по берегу, чтобы увидеть руины

День 7: ЧЕРНЫЙ ОСТРОВ – ЗАЛИВ ПОЙРАЗ - БОДРУМ 
Мы отправимся в круиз рано утром в Карааду (Черный остров). Завтрак и перерыв на плавание будут в бухте Пойраз, которая расположена на южной стороне острова. Это такой красивый залив с его бирюзово-голубыми водами. Мы пришвартуемся в гавани Бодрума на ужин и ночлег. Необязательно оставаться в ближайшей бухте на ночь и рано утром возвращаться в гавань Бодрума.

День 8: БОДРУМ 
Гости покинут лодку с драгоценными воспоминаниями к 10:30 после завтрака.

en.title: Gulet Laram Bodrum-Gokova-Bodrum
en.description: Chartering a private yacht; offers you ultimate flexibility on the itinerary... Boarding starts by 14:00 o'clock. On the first day, you will have the option to remain anchored in Bodrum Port or stay the night in a nearby bay.
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Day 1: BODRUM 
Boarding starts by 14:00 o'clock. On the first day, you will have the option to remain anchored in Bodrum Port or stay the night in a nearby bay.

Day 2: ORAK ISLAND - COKERTME 
After your breakfast, we will cruise to Orak Island. Here you will have the opportunity of swimming in the crystal-blue waters of Orak Island and enjoying lunch. We will then sail to Cokertme, 'a small and picturesque fishing town' for dinner and an overnight stay. If the weather conditions permit, it may be possible to use the sail on the way. Guests are welcome to take a short walk on the shore.

Day 3: SEVEN ISLANDS ( KUFRE / UZUN LIMAN ) - ENGLISH HARBOUR 
Before breakfast in the early morning, we will cruise to Seven Islands. Our first stop in Seven Islands Region will be Kufre Bay. Then we will be anchoring at Uzun Liman (Long Port). Afterwards we will cruise to English Horbour for dinner and an overnight stay. The name, English Harbour, comes from the time of 2nd World War as the ships of British Navy forces used to dock here. In this area, there are so many small and large bays which are suitable and sheltered enough to anchor for the boats.

Day 4: CLEOPATRA ISLAND - KARACASOGUT 
We will cruise to Sedir (Cedrae or Cleopatra Island. This unique island with its small beach and unbelievable clear water is like an open-air museum. Then our boat will sail to Karacasogut village for dinner and spend the night there. This lovely village is located at 25 km away from Marmaris. Therefore, it is possible to visit Marmaris with a 40 minutes mini bus trip. We also have an optional tour to Dalyan  and Caunos.

Day 5: LONGOZ - TUZLA 
Morning swimming will soon become a part of your daily activities. For lunch, our captain will cruise to Longoz Bay; another place which is like paradise, sheltered with huge pine forests. After lunch, you can enjoy a short walk in the forest and take a rest in Ali Baba's local shed-like cafe. Afterwards the gulet will be anchoring at Tuzla Bay to enjoy a swimming break in the turquoise-blue waters. Dinner and overnight stay at Tuzla Bay.

Day 6: MAZI - KISEBUKU (ALAKISLA BUKU) 
We will be in Mazi early in the morning. After lunch, we will be anchoring at Kisebuku (Alakisla Buku).Here you can see the ancient ruins. We will spend the night in this lovely bay.

Day 7: PABUCBURNU - BLACK ISLAND - BODRUM 
We will sail to Pabucburnu after breakfast and enjoy lunch here. Tea will be served in Yaliciftlik Bay. An optional village tour can be arranged from this bay for those who are wishing to experience the local life. Then our boat will cruise back to Bodrum Port for the last day's dinner and an overnight stay. Optional is to stay in a near bay for the night and return to Bodrum harbour early in the morning.

Day 8: BODRUM 
The guests will leave the boat with precious memories by 10:30 after breakfast.

tr.description: Özel yat kiralamak; seyahat programında size en üst düzeyde esneklik sunar... Biniş saat 14:00'da başlar. İlk gün Bodrum Limanı'nda demirli kalma veya geceyi yakındaki bir koyda geçirme seçeneğiniz olacak.
tr.bodyHtml:
Tur programı

1. Gün: BODRUM Biniş saat 14:00'da başlar. İlk gün Bodrum Limanı'nda demirli kalma veya geceyi yakındaki bir koyda geçirme seçeneğiniz olacak. 2. Gün: ORAK ADASI - ÇÖKERTME Sabah kahvaltımızın ardından Orak Adası'na hareket ediyoruz. Burada Orak Adası'nın masmavi sularında yüzme ve öğle yemeğinin tadını çıkarma fırsatı bulacaksınız. Daha sonra akşam yemeği ve geceleme için 'küçük ve pitoresk bir balıkçı kasabası' olan Çökertme'ye hareket edilir. Hava şartları izin verirse yolda yelken kullanmak mümkün olabilir. Konuklar kıyıda kısa bir yürüyüş yapabilirler. 3. Gün: YEDİ ADALAR ( KUFRE / UZUN LİMAN ) - İNGİLİZ LİMANI Sabah erken saatlerde kahvaltıdan önce Yedi Adalar'a hareket edilir. Yedi Adalar Bölgesi'ndeki ilk durağımız Küfre Koyu olacak. Ardından Uzun Liman'a demirleyeceğiz. Daha sonra akşam yemeği ve geceleme için English Horbour'a demirlenir. İngiliz Limanı adı, 2. Dünya Savaşı sırasında İngiliz Donanması kuvvetlerinin gemilerinin buraya yanaşmasından gelir. Bu bölgede tekneler için demirlemeye uygun ve yeterince korunaklı irili ufaklı pek çok koy bulunmaktadır. 4. Gün: KLEOPATRA ADASI - KARACASOGUT Sedir'e (Cedrae veya Kleopatra Adası) demirlenir. Küçük kumsalı ve inanılmaz berrak suları ile bu eşsiz ada adeta bir açık hava müzesi gibidir. Daha sonra teknemiz akşam yemeği için Karacasöğüt köyüne hareket eder ve geceyi burada geçirir. Marmaris'e 25 km uzaklıkta yer almaktadır.Bu nedenle 40 dakikalık bir minibüs yolculuğu ile Marmaris'i ziyaret etmek mümkündür.Ayrıca isteğe bağlı Dalyan  ve Kaunos turumuz vardır. 5. Gün: LONGÖZ - TUZLA Sabah yüzmek yakında günlük aktivitelerinizin bir parçası olacak. Öğle yemeği için kaptanımız Longoz Koyu'na hareket edecek; koskoca çam ormanlarıyla korunaklı cennet gibi bir başka yer. Öğle yemeğinden sonra ormanda kısa bir yürüyüş yapabilir, Ali Baba'nın yerel kulübe benzeri kafesinde dinlenebilirsiniz. Daha sonra gulet turkuaz mavisi sularda yüzme molası vermek için Tuzla Koyu'na demirlenecektir. Akşam yemeği ve geceleme Tuzla Koyu'nda. 6. Gün: MAZİ - KİŞEBÜKÜ (ALAKISLA BÜKÜ) Sabah erken saatlerde Mazi'de olacağız. Öğle yemeğinden sonra Kisebükü'ne (Alakışla Bükü) demirlenir. Burada antik kalıntıları görebilirsiniz. Geceyi bu şirin koyda geçireceğiz. 7. Gün: PABUCBURNU - KARAADA - BODRUM Sabah kahvaltısının ardından Pabuçburnu'na hareket edilir ve öğle yemeği burada alınır. Çay servisi Yalıçiftlik Koyu'nda yapılacaktır. Yerel hayatı deneyimlemek isteyenler için bu koydan isteğe bağlı olarak köy turu düzenlenebilmektedir. Daha sonra teknemiz son gün akşam yemeği ve geceleme için Bodrum Limanı'na hareket eder. İsteğe bağlı olarak geceyi yakın bir koyda geçirmek ve sabah erken saatlerde Bodrum limanına dönmek mümkündür. 8. Gün: BODRUM Misafirler, kahvaltının ardından saat 10:30'a kadar değerli anılarla tekneden ayrılacaklar.

ru.title: Гулет Ларам Бодрум-Гокова-Бодрум
ru.description: Аренда частной яхты; предлагает вам максимальную гибкость в выборе маршрута... Посадка начинается в 14:00. В первый день у вас будет возможность остаться на якоре в порту Бодрума или переночевать в соседней бухте.
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

День 1: БОДРУМ 
Посадка начинается в 14:00. В первый день у вас будет возможность остаться на якоре в порту Бодрума или переночевать в соседней бухте.

День 2: ОСТРОВ ОРАК - КОКЕРТМЕ 
После вашего завтрака мы отправимся в круиз на остров Орак. Здесь у вас будет возможность поплавать в кристально-голубых водах острова Орак и насладиться обедом. Затем мы отправимся в Кокертме, "маленький и живописный рыбацкий городок", чтобы поужинать и переночевать. Если позволят погодные условия, в пути можно будет воспользоваться парусом. Гости могут совершить короткую прогулку по берегу.

День 3: СЕМЬ ОСТРОВОВ (КУФРЕ/УЗУН-ЛИМАН) - АНГЛИЙСКАЯ ГАВАНЬ 
Ранним утром перед завтраком мы отправимся в круиз на Семь островов. Нашей первой остановкой в регионе Семи островов будет залив Куфре. Затем мы встанем на якорь в Узун Лиман (Длинный порт). После этого мы отправимся в круиз в Английский Хорбор на ужин и ночлег. Название "Английская гавань" происходит от времен 2-й мировой войны, когда здесь швартовались корабли британских военно-морских сил. В этом районе так много маленьких и больших бухт, которые подходят и достаточно защищены, чтобы бросить якорь для лодок.

День 4: ОСТРОВ КЛЕОПАТРЫ - КАРАКАСОГУТ 
Мы отправимся в круиз в Седир (Седра или остров Клеопатры. Этот уникальный остров с его небольшим пляжем и невероятно чистой водой похож на музей под открытым небом. Затем наша лодка отправится в деревню Каракасогут на ужин и проведет там ночь. Эта прекрасная деревня расположена в 25 км от Мармариса. Таким образом, можно посетить Мармарис с 40-минутной поездкой на мини-автобусе. У нас также есть дополнительный тур в Дальян и Каунос.

День 5: ЛОНГОЗ - ТУЗЛА 
Утреннее плавание скоро станет частью вашей повседневной деятельности. На обед наш капитан отправится в бухту Лонгоз - еще одно место, похожее на рай, укрытое огромными сосновыми лесами. После обеда вы можете насладиться короткой прогулкой по лесу и отдохнуть в местном кафе, похожем на сарай Али-Бабы. После этого гулет встанет на якорь в бухте Тузла, чтобы насладиться купанием в бирюзово-голубых водах. Ужин и ночлег в бухте Тузла.

День 6: МАЗИ-КИСЕБУКУ (АЛАКИСЛА БУКУ) 
Мы будем в Маци ранним утром. После обеда мы встанем на якорь в Кисебуку (Алакисла Буку).Здесь вы можете увидеть древние руины. Мы проведем ночь в этой прекрасной бухте.

День 7: ПАБУКБУРНУ - ЧЕРНЫЙ ОСТРОВ - БОДРУМ 
После завтрака мы отправимся в Пабукбурну и пообедаем здесь. Чай будет подан в бухте Яличифтлик. Для тех, кто хочет познакомиться с местной жизнью, из этой бухты может быть организована дополнительная экскурсия по деревне. Затем наша лодка отправится обратно в порт Бодрума, чтобы поужинать в последний день и переночевать. Необязательно оставаться в ближайшей бухте на ночь и рано утром возвращаться в гавань Бодрума.

День 8: БОДРУМ 
Гости покинут лодку с драгоценными воспоминаниями к 10:30 после завтрака.

en.title: Highlights of Ephesus & House of the Virgin Mary
en.description: Virgin Mary Temple of Artemis Domitian's,Trajan's,Hadrian' Temples Ephesus tour from Kusadasi or Izmir
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Your private Ephesus Tour Guide will welcome you at Kusadasi port or hotel.Then you will meet your private driver and get on a luxurious, A/C, comfortable veichle. After 30 minutes’ drive, you will arrive to Ephesus. Your Ephesus Tour Guide will have the entrance tickets ready for you to skip the lines.Your Ephesus Tour will start at the upper gate and finish at the lower gate of Ancient Ephesus City.  You will see  Domitian's, Trajan’s and  Hadrian's Temples, the huge Roman bath, Harbour Street, Marble Street, the Gates of Mihridates and Mazues, Commercial Agora, Latrina, the Scolastica Baths, Curetes Street, Polio Fountain, Memnius’ Monument, the Prytaneion, Odeon, the State Agora, the Celsus Library and the biggest amphitheater in Turkey. 

Leaving Ephesus, you will visit The House of the Virgin Mary which is located in a nature park between Ephesus and Selcuk.This is believed to be the last residence of the Virgin Mary, Mother of Jesus. The peaceful site is sacred to both Christians and Muslims and is visited by many tourists and pilgrims. This House was later visited by Popes Paul VI and John Paul II, who confirmed its appropriateness as a place of pilgrimage. On November 29, 2006, Pope Benedict XVI celebrated mass here.

You will have a traditional Turkish lunch in a peacefull and non-toursity restaurant close to Ephesus. Then you will visit Temple of Artemis. Artemis was the main goddess of Ephesus and the Ephesians built the biggest ancient temple ever dedicated to her.  

At the end of your Ephesus Tour,  your tour guide and driver will drop you back to Kusadasi Port on time.

tr.description: Meryemana Artemis Tapınağı Domitian'ın, Trajan'ın, Hadrian'ın Tapınakları Kuşadası veya İzmir'den Efes turu
tr.bodyHtml:
Tur programı

Özel Efes Tur Rehberiniz sizi Kuşadası limanında veya otelde karşılayacaktır. Daha sonra özel şoförünüzle buluşup lüks, klimalı, konforlu bir araca bineceksiniz. Arabayla 30 dakika sonra Efes'e varacaksınız. Efes Tur Rehberiniz giriş biletlerini sıra beklemeden hazırlayacaktır. Efes Turunuz Antik Efes Kenti'nin üst kapısından başlayıp alt kapısında bitecektir. Domitian'ın, Trajan'ın ve Hadrian'ın Tapınaklarını, devasa Roma hamamını, Liman Sokağı, Mermer Cadde, Mihridates ve Mazu Kapıları, Ticaret Agorası, Latrina, Scolastica Hamamları, Curetes Sokağı, Çocuk Felci Çeşmesi, Memnius Anıtı, Prytaneion'u göreceksiniz. Odeon, Devlet Agorası, Celsus Kütüphanesi ve Türkiye'nin en büyük amfitiyatrosu. Efes'ten ayrılarak, Efes ve Selçuk arasındaki bir tabiat parkında bulunan Meryem Ana Evi'ni ziyaret edeceksiniz. Burasının İsa'nın Annesi Meryem Ana'nın son ikametgahı olduğuna inanılıyor. Huzurlu site hem Hıristiyanlar hem de Müslümanlar için kutsaldır ve birçok turist ve hacı tarafından ziyaret edilmektedir. Bu Ev daha sonra, bir hac yeri olarak uygunluğunu onaylayan Papa VI.Paul ve II. John Paul tarafından ziyaret edildi. 29 Kasım 2006'da Papa 16. Benedict burada ayini kutladı. Efes'e yakın sakin ve turistik olmayan bir restoranda geleneksel bir Türk öğle yemeği yiyeceksiniz. Ardından Artemis Tapınağı'nı ziyaret edeceksiniz. Artemis, Efes'in ana tanrıçasıydı ve Efesliler ona adanmış en büyük antik tapınağı inşa ettiler. Efes Turunuzun sonunda, tur rehberiniz ve şoförünüz sizi zamanında Kuşadası Limanı'na bırakacaktır.

ru.title: Основные достопримечательности Эфеса и Дом Девы Марии
ru.description: Virgin Mary Temple of Artemis Domitian's,Trajan's,Hadrian' Temples Тур по Эфесу на полдня из Кушадасы или Измира
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

Ваш личный гид по Эфесу встретит вас в порту Кушадасы или порту Измира. Затем вы встретитесь со своим личным водителем и сядете в роскошный, комфортабельный veichle с кондиционером. Через 20 минут езды вы прибудете в Эфес. У вашего гида по Эфесу будут готовы входные билеты, чтобы вы могли пропустить очереди.Ваш тур по Эфесу начнется у верхних ворот и закончится у нижних ворот Древнего города Эфес.  Вы увидите Храмы Домициана, Траяна и Адриана, огромные римские бани, Харбор-стрит, Мраморную улицу, Ворота Михридата и Мазуеса, Торговую Агору, Латрину, Бани Сколастика, улицу Кюретес, Фонтан Полиомиелита, Памятник Мемнию, Пританеон, Одеон, Государственную Агору, Библиотеку Цельса и самый большой амфитеатр в Турции. 

Покинув Эфес, вы посетите Дом Девы Марии, который расположен в природном парке между Эфесом и Сельчуком.Считается, что это последнее место жительства Девы Марии, Матери Иисуса. Это мирное место является священным как для христиан, так и для мусульман и посещается многими туристами и паломниками. Позже этот дом посетили папы Павел VI и Иоанн Павел II, которые подтвердили его целесообразность в качестве места паломничества. 29 ноября 2006 года Папа Бенедикт XVI отслужил здесь мессу.

Вы пообедаете традиционным турецким обедом в тихом и непринужденном ресторане недалеко от Эфеса. Затем вы посетите Храм Артемиды. Артемида была главной богиней Эфеса, и эфесяне построили самый большой древний храм, когда-либо посвященный ей.  

В конце вашего тура по Эфесу ваш гид и водитель доставят вас обратно в порт Кушадасы вовремя.

en.title: In The Steps Of Alexander The Great
en.description: One of history's most famous leaders. When he entered Turkey via the Dardanelles nobody knew that we was about to make history - and he made most of it in Turkey.
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

1st Day: You will arrive to Istanbul, the biggest city of modern Turkey. We will welcome you and you will rest in the hotel.

2nd Day: We will have an extensive tour of Istanbul. Istanbul is the only city located in 2 continents and was the capital city of 3 empires. Our first visit will be to the legendary St. Sophia which was built 1.500 years ago as the first cathedral of the world. It was the biggest and last construction of The Roman Empire. Following that we will visit the famous Blue Mosque. After lunch you will have free time in one of the oldest shopping places in the world, the Grand Bazaar. Overnight in Istanbul.

3rd Day: In the morning we will have a Bosphorus cruise tour and you will see the beauty of Istanbul. Next we will visit the Topkapi Palace and famous Spice Bazaar. In the afternoon you will visit the Underground Cistern. Overnight in Istanbul.

4th Day: You will drive 3.30 hours from Istanbul to Canakkale and by ferryboat in 1 hour time you will reach Asia from Europe. After lunch you will visit the Legendary Homeric Troy. Overnight in Canakkale.

5th Day: Leaving Troy, you will arrive to Pergamum which is consisting of 2 sites; the Acropolis where the Kings of Pergamum used to stay and the Asclepion one of the oldest and biggest ancient hospitals in Anatolia took place. Pergamum is also the place where the first paper (parchment) was made. Overnight in Izmir.

6th Day: Today you will see the Ancient City Sardis which was the capital of the Lydian Kingdom. This site where the coin money was first produced and used is mentioned in the old and new testament. After lunch, you will leave for the famous cruiser town Kusadasi. Enjoy your dinner in a sea food restaurant. Overnight in Kusadasi.

7th Day: A spectacular day is waiting for you. For a few hours feel like a Roman citizen living in the history of the ancient site of Ephesus. You will have an extensive tour in this ancient site where you will see the Hadrian’s, Trajan’s and the Domitian’s Temples, the huge Roman bath, the Celcus Library and the biggest amphitheater of Turkey. After lunch you will visit the Ephesus museum where the foundings of excavations in the site are displayed. The main goddess of Ephesus was Artemis and the Ephesians dedicated her the biggest ancient temple ever built. A visit to the ruins of Artemision which is one of the Seven World Wonder is our last stop of the day. Turn back to Kusadasi where you will have dinner and overnight.

8th Day: Another archeological day is waiting for you since today you will make the famous PMD Tour; our first stop will be in Priene, which is an ancient city dedicated to Goddess Athena. Later we will drive to Miletos, which was a science and cultural centre in the ancient time. After lunch we will visit Didyma which means twins in Greek for God Apollo and his twin sister Artemis. The biggest oracle temple which was dedicated to Apollo has been erected in Didyma. Watching the temple you will enjoy your lunch. Following on the way to Bodrum our bus will pass the Bafa Lake where you will have a coffee break. Overnight in Bodrum.

9th Day: You will wake up in the very attractive coastal town Bodrum. Here first of all you will visit the ruins of one of the Seven World Wonder, the Mausoleum of Halicarnassos. Finally you will visit the famous St. Peter Castle, built by the Temple Knights where you will listen to the classical music and drink your wine in the English Tower. Also there you will see there Underwater Water Archeological Museum. After having lunch we are going to drive to Fethiye where we will stay for the night.

10th Day: Fethiye is another coastal town surrounded by forest. Before we will Fehtiye you will have a look to the monumental tombs of Lycian Kings and Kayaköy known as the ‘Ghost Town‘. Our day will continue by driving to a nice tiny town named Finike. Here embark on a comfortable Gullet, where you will spend 2 nights on since Alexander the Great sent his army on land but preferred to go to Phaselis by boat. After a few hours sailing you will be at Olympus , once an ancient harbor. Overnight at the Gullet.

11th Day: After such a beautiful day, today our gullet will sail along the coast of the Mediterranean and we will have an enjoyable rest.

12th Day: As Alexander the Great’s boat did in the past, your Gullet will anchor at the harbor of the ancient site of Phaselis. After visiting the site our bus will bring us to famous city of Antalya. Before we check in to our luxurious hotel the doors of the Archeological Museum of Antalya will open for you. Overnight in Antalya.

13th Day: A full extensive archeological day is waiting for you. Our first trip is to Ancient city of Perge where St. Paul visited with St. Mark. We will the well preserved ruins of the Roman Era. Further, we will reach to Aspendos where the most well preserved ancient theater is situated. After lunch we will visit a very coastal town where the ancient city of Side located. Overnight in Antalya.

14th Day: After 2 nights stay in Antalya, you will departure for Gordion. Passing the Taurus Mountain our bus will reach the Central Anatolia. This is the place Alexander the Great cut the Gordions knot. Later you will check in to your hotel in Ankara, the capital city of Turkey.

15th Day: The day starts with a visit to the Anatolian Civilization Museum in Ankara. After a photo break at the Modern Mausoleum of Ataturk, who is the founder of Turkey. Our bus will drive to Cappadocia where the fairy chimneys are located. Overnight in Cappadocia.

16th Day: Today you will see dreamlike Cappadocia, Goreme open air museum, monasteries and churches with the most beautiful frescos inside founded by St. Basil. Overnight in Cappadocia.

17th Day: Before the breakfast you have an opportunity to take a fascinating balloon tour and have a chance to view the unforgettable view of Cappadoccia. Later we will see Uchisar, Urgup, Avanos, Zelve and the famous underground city where early period Christians were living and hiding. After dinner watch the whirling dervishes show, representing the Sufism from the 13th C.AD Overnight in Cappadocia.

18th Day: Transfer to the airport for your homebound flight via Istanbul.

de.title: Auf den Spuren des großen Alexanders
de.description: Einer der berühmtesten Führer der Geschichte. Als er über die Dardanellen in die Türkei kam, wusste niemand, dass wir Geschichte schreiben würden – und das meiste davon hat er in der Türkei gemacht.
de.bodyHtml:
Reiseverlauf

1. Tag: Sie erreichen Istanbul, die größte Stadt der modernen Türkei. Wir heißen Sie willkommen und Sie werden sich im Hotel ausruhen.

2. Tag: Wir werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch Istanbul machen. Istanbul ist die einzige Stadt auf 2 Kontinenten und war die Hauptstadt von 3 Reichen. Unser erster Besuch ist die sagenumwobene Hagia Sophia, die vor 1.500 Jahren als erste Kathedrale der Welt erbaut wurde. Es war das größte und letzte Bauwerk des Römischen Reiches. Anschließend besuchen wir die berühmte Blaue Moschee. Nach dem Mittagessen haben Sie Freizeit in einem der ältesten Einkaufszentren der Welt, dem Großen Basar. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

3. Tag: Am Morgen werden wir eine Bosporus-Kreuzfahrttour machen und Sie werden die Schönheit von Istanbul sehen. Als nächstes besuchen wir den Topkapi Palast und den berühmten Gewürzbasar. Am Nachmittag besuchen Sie die unterirdische Zisterne. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

4. Tag: Sie fahren 3,30 Stunden von Istanbul nach Canakkale und erreichen mit der Fähre in 1 Stunde Asien von Europa. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen Sie das legendäre homerische Troja. Übernachtung in anakkale.

5. Tag: Sie verlassen Troja und erreichen Pergamon, das aus 2 Orten besteht; die Akropolis, wo die Könige von Pergamon wohnten, und das Asklepion, eines der ältesten und größten antiken Krankenhäuser in Anatolien. Pergamon ist auch der Ort, an dem das erste Papier (Pergament) hergestellt wurde. Übernachtung in Izmir.

6. Tag: Heute sehen Sie die antike Stadt Sardes, die Hauptstadt des lydischen Königreichs. Dieser Ort, an dem das Münzgeld erstmals hergestellt und verwendet wurde, wird im Alten und Neuen Testament erwähnt. Nach dem Mittagessen fahren Sie in die berühmte Kreuzerstadt Kusadasi. Genießen Sie Ihr Abendessen in einem Fischrestaurant. Übernachtung in Kusadas.

7. Tag: Ein spektakulärer Tag erwartet Sie. Fühlen Sie sich für ein paar Stunden wie ein römischer Bürger, der in der Geschichte der antiken Stätte von Ephesus lebt. Sie werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch diese antike Stätte machen, bei der Sie die Tempel des Hadrian, des Trajan und des Domitian, das riesige römische Bad, die Celcus-Bibliothek und das größte Amphitheater der Türkei sehen. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen Sie das Ephesus-Museum, in dem die Funde der Ausgrabungen in der Stätte ausgestellt sind. Die Hauptgöttin von Ephesus war Artemis und die Epheser weihten ihr den größten je gebauten antiken Tempel. Ein Besuch der Ruinen von Artemision, die zu den Sieben Weltwundern zählen, ist unsere letzte Station des Tages. Kehren Sie nach Kusadasi zurück, wo Sie zu Abend essen und übernachten.

8. Tag: Ein weiterer archäologischer Tag erwartet Sie, da Sie heute die berühmte PMD-Tour machen; Unser erster Halt wird in Priene sein, einer antiken Stadt, die der Göttin Athena gewidmet ist. Später fahren wir nach Miletos, das in der Antike ein Wissenschafts- und Kulturzentrum war. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen wir Didyma, was auf Griechisch Zwillinge für Gott Apollo und seine Zwillingsschwester Artemis bedeutet. In Didyma wurde der größte Orakeltempel errichtet, der Apollo geweiht war. Beim Beobachten des Tempels genießen Sie Ihr Mittagessen. Auf dem Weg nach Bodrum fährt unser Bus am Bafa-See vorbei, wo Sie eine Kaffeepause einlegen. Übernachtung in Bodrum.

9. Tag: Sie wachen in der sehr attraktiven Küstenstadt Bodrum auf. Hier besuchen Sie zunächst die Ruinen eines der Sieben Weltwunder, das Mausoleum von Halicarnassos. Schließlich besuchen Sie das berühmte St. Peter Castle, erbaut von den Tempelrittern, wo Sie im Englischen Turm klassische Musik hören und Ihren Wein trinken. Dort sehen Sie auch das Unterwasser-Archäologische Museum. Nach dem Mittagessen fahren wir nach Fethiye, wo wir die Nacht verbringen werden.

10. Tag: Fethiye ist eine weitere Küstenstadt, umgeben von Wald. Bevor wir Fehtiye erreichen, werfen Sie einen Blick auf die monumentalen Gräber der lykischen Könige und Kayaköy, die als „Geisterstadt“ bekannt sind. Unser Tag wird mit einer Fahrt in eine nette kleine Stadt namens Finike fortgesetzt. Hier begeben Sie sich auf eine komfortable Gullet, in der Sie 2 Nächte verbringen werden, da Alexander der Große seine Armee an Land schickte, aber lieber mit dem Boot nach Phaselis fuhr. Nach ein paar Stunden Segeln sind Sie am Olymp, einst ein alter Hafen. Übernachtung im Gulet.

11. Tag: Nach einem so schönen Tag segelt unsere Speiseröhre heute entlang der Mittelmeerküste und wir werden uns eine angenehme Rast gönnen.

12. Tag: Wie in der Vergangenheit das Boot von Alexander dem Großen, wird Ihre Gullet im Hafen der antiken Stätte von Phaselis ankern. Nach dem Besuch der Stätte bringt uns unser Bus in die berühmte Stadt Antalya. Bevor wir in unser luxuriöses Hotel einchecken, öffnen sich die Türen des Archäologischen Museums von Antalya für Sie. Übernachtung in Antalya.

13. Tag: Ein umfangreicher archäologischer Tag erwartet Sie. Unsere erste Reise führt in die antike Stadt Perge, wo St. Paul mit St. Markus besuchte. Wir werden die gut erhaltenen Ruinen der Römerzeit besichtigen. Weiter erreichen wir Aspendos, wo sich das am besten erhaltene antike Theater befindet. Nach dem Mittagessen besuchen wir eine Küstenstadt, in der sich die antike Stadt Side befindet. Übernachtung in Antalya.

14. Tag: Nach 2 Nächten Aufenthalt in Antalya Abfahrt nach Gordion. Vorbei am Taurusgebirge erreicht unser Bus Zentralanatolien. Dies ist der Ort, an dem Alexander der Große den Gordions-Knoten durchschnitt. Später checken Sie in Ihrem Hotel in Ankara, der Hauptstadt der Türkei, ein.

15. Tag: Der Tag beginnt mit einem Besuch des Anatolian Civilization Museum in Ankara. Nach einer Fotopause im Modernen Mausoleum von Atatürk, dem Gründer der Türkei. Unser Bus fährt nach Kappadokien, wo sich die Feenkamine befinden. Übernachtung in Kappadokien.

16. Tag: Heute sehen Sie das traumhafte Kappadokien, Göreme Freilichtmuseum, Klöster und Kirchen mit den schönsten Fresken im Inneren, gegründet von St. Basilius. Übernachtung in Kappadokien.

17. Tag: Vor dem Frühstück haben Sie Gelegenheit, eine faszinierende Ballonfahrt zu unternehmen und die unvergessliche Aussicht auf Kappadokien zu genießen. Später werden wir Uchisar, Urgup, Avanos, Zelve und die berühmte unterirdische Stadt sehen, in der die Christen der frühen Zeit lebten und sich versteckten. Nach dem Abendessen sehen Sie sich die wirbelnde Derwische an, die den Sufismus aus dem 13. Jh. n. Chr. darstellen. Übernachtung in Kappadokien.

18. Tag: Transfer zum Flughafen für Ihren Heimflug über Istanbul.

Alle Mahlzeiten während der täglichen Touren
