en.title: St. Paul's Ephesus Tour
en.description: Ancient Ephesus City Terraces Houses Virgin Mary Ancient Ephesus and St Paul in Ephesus
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Your private Ephesus Tour Guide will welcome you at Kusadasi port/hotel.Then you will meet your private driver and get on a luxurious, A/C, comfortable veichle. After 20 minutes’ drive you will arrive Ephesus. Your Ephesus Tour Guide will have the entrance tickets ready on the tour date. So you will skip the lines.Your Ephesus Tour will start at the upper gate and finish at the lower gate of Ancient Ephesus City.  You will have an extensive tour in this ancient site where you will see  Domitian's, Trajan’s and Hadrian’s Temples, the huge Roman bath, Harbour Street, Marble Street, the Gates of Mihridates and Mazues, Commercial Agora, Latrina, the Scolastica Baths, Curetes Street, Polio Fountain, Memnius’ Monument, the Prytaneion, Odeon, the State Agora, the Celsus Library and the biggest amphitheater in Turkey. 

In this touryou have the opportunity to spend half of you day in Ancient Ephesus. You will enjoy the Roman Ephesus, see the shop where St. Paul worked and spend time in the biggest Amphitheatre in Turkey, one of the most important ones in the world, where he preached. Did you know that St. Paul wrote the famous Ephesians letter for the citizens of Ephesus?

You will also have chance to see 2000 years old paintings in Terrace Houses which are unique in the world. Then you will visit the church named as Virgin Mary for the first time. This church is also very important as the 3rd ecumenical council was hold here in 431AD. You will enjoy visiting all of these places and feeling the history in this Ephesus tour.

After seeing the footprints of St. Paul in Ancient Ephesus, you will be transferred back to Kusadasi port / hotel.

de.description: Ancient Ephesus City Terraces Houses Virgin Mary Das antike Ephesus und der heilige Paulus in Ephesus
de.bodyHtml:
Reiseverlauf

Ihr privater Ephesus-Reiseleiter wird Sie am Hafen von Kusadasi oder Izmir begrüßen. Dann treffen Sie Ihren privaten Fahrer und steigen in ein luxuriöses, klimatisiertes und komfortables Fahrzeug. Nach 20 Fahrminuten erreichen Sie Ephesus. Ihr Ephesus-Reiseleiter hält die Eintrittskarten am Tourdatum bereit. Sie überspringen also die Warteschlangen. Ihre Ephesus-Tour beginnt am oberen Tor und endet am unteren Tor der antiken Stadt Ephesus. Sie werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch diese antike Stätte machen, bei der Sie die Tempel von Domitian, Trajan und Hadrian, das riesige römische Bad, die Harbour Street, die Marble Street, die Tore von Mihridates und Mazues, Commercial Agora, Latrina, die Scolastica Baths, Curetes Street sehen , Polio-Brunnen, Memnius-Denkmal, das Prytaneion, Odeon, die staatliche Agora, die Celsus-Bibliothek und das größte Amphitheater der Türkei.

Bei dieser Tour haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Hälfte Ihres Tages im antiken Ephesus zu verbringen. Sie werden das römische Ephesus genießen, den Laden sehen, in dem Paulus arbeitete und Zeit im größten Amphitheater der Türkei verbringen, einem der wichtigsten der Welt, wo er predigte. Wussten Sie, dass der heilige Paulus den berühmten Epheserbrief für die Bürger von Ephesus geschrieben hat?

Sie haben auch die Möglichkeit, 2000 Jahre alte Gemälde in den Terrassenhäusern zu sehen, die weltweit einzigartig sind. Dann besuchen Sie zum ersten Mal die Kirche mit dem Namen Jungfrau Maria. Diese Kirche ist auch sehr wichtig, da hier 431 n. Chr. das 3. Ökumenische Konzil abgehalten wurde. Sie werden es genießen, all diese Orte zu besuchen und die Geschichte dieser Ephesus-Tour zu spüren.

Nachdem Sie die Fußabdrücke des Heiligen Paulus im antiken Ephesus gesehen haben, werden Sie pünktlich zum Hafen von Kusadasi / Izmir zurückgebracht.

fr.title: Visite d'Ephése a Saint-Paul
fr.description: Ancient Ephesus City Terraces Houses Virgin Mary Ephése antique et St Paul a Ephése
fr.bodyHtml:
Itinéraire

Votre guide touristique privé d'Ephése vous accueillera au port de Kusadasi ou au port d'İzmir.Ensuite,vous rencontrerez votre chauffeur privé et monterez dans un véhicule luxueux,climatisé et confortable.Aprés 20 mn de route,vous arriverez a Ephése.Votre guide touristique d'Ephése aura les billets d'entrée prets a la date de la visite.Vous éviterez donc les files d'attente.Votre visite d'Ephése commencera a la porte supérieure et se terminera a la porte inférieure de l'ancienne ville d'Ephése.Vous aurez une visite approfondie dans ce site antique ou vous verrez les temples de Domitien,de Trajan et d'Hadrien,l'immense bain Romain la rue du port,la rue de marbre,les portes de Mihridates et de Mazues,l'agora commerciale,Latrina,les bains Scolastica,la rue des Curétes,la fontaine Polio,le monument de Memnius,le Prytaneion,l'Odéon,L'Agora d'Etat,la bibliothéque de Celsus et le plus grand amphithéatre de Turquie.

Au cours de cette visite,vous avez la possibilité de passer la moitié de votre journée dans l'ancienne Ephése.Vous apprécierez l'Ephése Romaine,vous verrez la boutique ou St Paul a travaillé et passerez du temps dans le plus grand amphithétre de Turquie,l'un des plus importants au monde,ou il a préché.Saviez-vous que Saint Paul a écrit la célébre lettre d'Ephése pour les citoyens d'Ephése?

Vous aurez également la chance de voir des peintures vieilles de 2000 ans dans les Maisons de Terrasse qui sont uniques au monde.Ensuite,vous visiterez pous la premiére fois l'église nommée Vierge Marie.Cette église est également trés importante car le 3éme concile oecuménique s'y est tenu.Vous appréciérez de visiter tous ces lieux et de ressentir l'histoire de cette visite d'Ephése.

Aprés avoir vu les empreintes de pas de St Paul dans l'ancienne Ephése,vous serez transfére a temps au port de Kusadasi/port d'İzmir.

en.title: The lost city of Sagalassos Tour
en.description: Hellenistic Fountain Private and Day Tour of Sagalassos
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Sagalassos Tours is one of the best attractions, if you are in Kusadasi area. You will be picked up from your hotel early in the morning.On the way you will visit the beautiful Lake of Salda which has an incredible blue color. Further there will be a stop at Insuyu Cave displaying great samples of stalactite and stalagmite which is 350 meters deep.

You will have lunch near by the ancient city of Sagalassos, while enjoying the great landscape of the area. Such a beautiful forest and mountain are surrounding the hotel where you will have lunch. After lunch there will be a 5 minutes’ drive to the lost city. Visit this legendary Sagalassos staring with the theater, which had a capacity of 9000 people. This theater was built 1500 meters oversee level, having a wonderful view to the valley, forest and mountain. Then you see the mosaics and Hellenistic fountain. Further you will visit the huge Antonino’s Fountain. It is the only fountain in an ancient city in Turkey which is connected to water. The original natural water which was running 1800 years ago into the pool of the fountain is running now again. You will also visit the other parts of the city.

At the end of the tour you will be dropped back to your hotel in Kusadasi.

en.title: The Mystical Turkey Tour
en.description: This tour is specially prepared to bring together most interesting and less studied cultural, religious, historic varieties of the country in one package. It will feel like a journey to the far corners of history of oldest established sects, life-style, architectural beauties where one feels one travels in time. A journey of a lifetime.
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

1st Day: You will arrive in Istanbul, the biggest city of modern Turkey. We will welcome you and you will relax in your hotel.

2nd Day: We will have an extensive tour of Istanbul. Istanbul is the only city located in 2 continentsand was the capital city of 3 empires. Our first visit will be to the legendary St. Sophia which was built 1.500 years ago as the first cathedral of the world. It was the biggest and last construction of The Roman Empire. Following we will visit the famous Blue Mosque. After lunch you will have free time in one of the oldest shopping places in the world, the Grand Bazaar. In the afternoon we will visit the Chora Museum which is one of the most beautiful samples of Byzantine art. Overnight in Istanbul.

3rd Day: In the morning we will have a Bosphorus cruise tour and you will see the beauty of Istanbul. Next we will visit the Topkapi Palace where the Ottoman Sultans used to rule the Empire. After lunch you will see the Underground Cistern and have free time in the famous Spice Bazaar. Overnight in Istanbul.

4th Day: We will from Istanbul to Mardin which is one of the most beautiful and attractive cities in the world. We will have a walk on the lovely streets of Mardin and have a dinner in a local restaurant. Overnight in Mardin.

5th Day: Today we will have one of the most mystic and magical days. First we will go to the ancient city of Hasan Keyf which will be under the waters of the River Tigris in a few years time. Then we will visit Midyat, famous for its architecture and we will have lunch there. Later we will visit Mardin, where we will visit the Jacobite Christian Church. Today will be the most memorable day since you will hear the Bible in the original language of Jesus Christ. Overnight in Mardin.

6th Day: Leaving Mardin via Diyarbakir we will take the ferryboat in Siverek and will reach to Kahta in 15 minutes. We will drive to the Nemrut Mountain which is reckoned to be the 8th wonder of the world. There we will see 2metre high statues of legendary Gods and Goddesses. Overnight in Adiyaman.

7th Day: On the way to Urfa we will see Ataturk Dam which is one of the biggest in the world. We will go to the Biblical City of Harran, where we will see the famous Harran houses and the first Islamic University. According the Old Testament Harran is the place where Prophet Abraham and his children spent 7 years before leaving for Israel. Walking in the city Urfa, we will see Prophet Abraham’s birth place and the bazaar. Overnight in Urfa.

8th Day: We will see Halfeti and the Mosaic Museum in Antep and will arrive to King Solomon’s Antakya passing Coa Plateau which is mentioned in the Old Testament.. Overnight in Antakya.

9th Day: Today we will visit St. Peter’s Church which was the first established in the world. Then we will visit the famous church in Samandag where was always the starting point of the apostles. Overnight in Antakya.

10th Day: Leaving Antakya, on the way we will visit Tarsus, birth place of St. Paul and walking through ancient Tarsus we will reach St. Paul’s Well. Overnight in Mersin.

11th Day: Today we will drive along the wonderful Mediterranean coast of Turkey and see Cennet (Heaven) – Cehennem (Hell) and Seleucia and will reach in Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

12th Day: Free day in Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

13th Day: Our first trip is to the ancient city of Perge which St. Paul visited with St. Mark. We will visit the well preserved ruins of the Roman Era. Later, we will travel to Aspendos where a most well preserved ancient theater is situated. After lunch we will have the chance to visit the museum optionally with no extra charge. Overnight Antalya.

14th Day: Transfer to Antalya airport. Fly home via Istanbul

de.title: Die mystische Türkei-Tour
de.description: Diese Tour wurde speziell vorbereitet, um die interessantesten und weniger erforschten kulturellen, religiösen und historischen Varianten des Landes in einem Paket zu vereinen. Es wird sich wie eine Reise in die entlegensten Winkel der Geschichte der ältesten etablierten Sekten, des Lebensstils und der architektonischen Schönheiten anfühlen, bei denen man das Gefühl hat, in der Zeit zu reisen. Eine Reise Ihres Lebens.
de.bodyHtml:
Reiseverlauf

1. Tag: Sie erreichen Istanbul, die größte Stadt der modernen Türkei. Wir heißen Sie herzlich willkommen und Sie werden sich in Ihrem Hotel erholen.

2. Tag: Wir werden eine ausgedehnte Tour durch Istanbul machen. Istanbul ist die einzige Stadt auf 2 Kontinenten und war die Hauptstadt von 3 Reichen. Unser erster Besuch ist die sagenumwobene Hagia Sophia, die vor 1.500 Jahren als erste Kathedrale der Welt erbaut wurde. Es war das größte und letzte Bauwerk des Römischen Reiches. Anschließend besuchen wir die berühmte Blaue Moschee. Nach dem Mittagessen haben Sie Freizeit in einem der ältesten Einkaufszentren der Welt, dem Großen Basar. Am Nachmittag besuchen wir das Chora Museum, eines der schönsten Beispiele byzantinischer Kunst. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

3. Tag: Am Morgen werden wir eine Bosporus-Kreuzfahrttour machen und Sie werden die Schönheit von Istanbul sehen. Als nächstes besuchen wir den Topkapi-Palast, in dem die osmanischen Sultane das Reich regierten. Nach dem Mittagessen sehen Sie die unterirdische Zisterne und haben Freizeit im berühmten Gewürzbasar. Übernachtung in Istanbul.

4. Tag: Wir fahren von Istanbul nach Mardin, einer der schönsten und attraktivsten Städte der Welt. Wir werden einen Spaziergang durch die schönen Straßen von Mardin machen und in einem lokalen Restaurant zu Abend essen. Übernachtung in Mardin.

5. Tag: Heute erleben wir einen der mystischsten und magischsten Tage. Zuerst fahren wir in die antike Stadt Hasan Keyf, die in einigen Jahren unter dem Wasser des Tigris liegen wird. Dann besuchen wir Midyat, berühmt für seine Architektur, und essen dort zu Mittag. Später besuchen wir Mardin, wo wir die Jacobite Christian Church besuchen. Heute wird der denkwürdigste Tag sein, da Sie die Bibel in der Originalsprache von Jesus Christus hören werden. Übernachtung in Mardin.

6. Tag: Von Mardin über Diyarbakir nehmen wir die Fähre in Siverek und erreichen Kahta in 15 Minuten. Wir fahren zum Nemrut Berg, der als 8. Weltwunder gilt. Dort werden wir 2 Meter hohe Statuen legendärer Götter und Göttinnen sehen. Übernachtung in Adiyaman.

7. Tag: Auf dem Weg nach Urfa sehen wir den Atatürk-Staudamm, einen der größten der Welt. Wir fahren in die biblische Stadt Harran, wo wir die berühmten Harran-Häuser und die erste islamische Universität sehen. Nach dem Alten Testament ist Harran der Ort, an dem der Prophet Abraham und seine Kinder 7 Jahre verbrachten, bevor sie nach Israel aufbrachen. Bei einem Spaziergang durch die Stadt Urfa werden wir den Geburtsort des Propheten Abraham und den Basar sehen. Übernachtung in Urfa.

8. Tag: Wir sehen Halfeti und das Mosaikmuseum in Antep und erreichen König Salomos Antakya über das im Alten Testament erwähnte Coa-Plateau. Übernachtung in Antakya.

9. Tag: Heute besuchen wir die Peterskirche, die als erste der Welt errichtet wurde. Dann besuchen wir die berühmte Kirche in Samandag, wo immer der Ausgangspunkt der Apostel war. Übernachtung in Antakya.

10. Tag: Wir verlassen Antakya, auf dem Weg besuchen wir Tarsus, den Geburtsort von St. Paul und wandern durch das antike Tarsus und erreichen den St. Paul's Well. Übernachtung in Mersin.

11. Tag: Heute fahren wir entlang der wunderschönen Mittelmeerküste der Türkei und sehen Cennet (Himmel) – Cehennem (Hölle) und Seleucia und erreichen Antalya. Übernachtung in Antalya.

12. Tag: Freier Tag in Antalya. Übernachtung in Antalya.

13. Tag: Unser erster Ausflug führt in die antike Stadt Perge, die St. Paul mit St. Markus besuchte. Wir besuchen die gut erhaltenen Ruinen der Römerzeit. Später fahren wir nach Aspendos, wo sich ein am besten erhaltenes antikes Theater befindet. Nach dem Mittagessen haben wir die Möglichkeit, das Museum optional ohne Aufpreis zu besuchen. Übernachtung Antalya.

14. Tag: Transfer zum Flughafen Antalya. Über Istanbul nach Hause fliegen

After lunch you will see the Underground Cistern and have free time in the famous Spice Bazaar. Overnight in Istanbul.

4th Day: We will from Istanbul to Mardin which is one of the most beautiful and attractive cities in the world. We will have a walk on the lovely streets of Mardin and have a dinner in a local restaurant. Overnight in Mardin.

5th Day: Today we will have one of the most mystic and magical days. First we will go to the ancient city of Hasan Keyf which will be under the waters of the River Tigris in a few years time. Then we will visit Midyat, famous for its architecture and we will have lunch there. Later we will visit Mardin, where we will visit the Jacobite Christian Church. Today will be the most memorable day since you will hear the Bible in the original language of Jesus Christ. Overnight in Mardin.

6th Day: Leaving Mardin via Diyarbakir we will take the ferryboat in Siverek and will reach to Kahta in 15 minutes. We will drive to the Nemrut Mountain which is reckoned to be the 8th wonder of the world. There we will see 2metre high statues of legendary Gods and Goddesses. Overnight in Adiyaman.

7th Day: On the way to Urfa we will see Ataturk Dam which is one of the biggest in the world. We will go to the Biblical City of Harran, where we will see the famous Harran houses and the first Islamic University. According the Old Testament Harran is the place where Prophet Abraham and his children spent 7 years before leaving for Israel. Walking in the city Urfa, we will see Prophet Abraham’s birth place and the bazaar. Overnight in Urfa.

8th Day: We will see Halfeti and the Mosaic Museum in Antep and will arrive to King Solomon’s Antakya passing Coa Plateau which is mentioned in the Old Testament.. Overnight in Antakya.

9th Day: Today we will visit St. Peter’s Church which was the first established in the world. Then we will visit the famous church in Samandag where was always the starting point of the apostles. Overnight in Antakya.

10th Day: Leaving Antakya, on the way we will visit Tarsus, birth place of St. Paul and walking through ancient Tarsus we will reach St. Paul’s Well. Overnight in Mersin.

11th Day: Today we will drive along the wonderful Mediterranean coast of Turkey and see Cennet (Heaven) – Cehennem (Hell) and Seleucia and will reach in Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

12th Day: Free day in Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

13th Day: Our first trip is to the ancient city of Perge which St. Paul visited with St. Mark. We will visit the well preserved ruins of the Roman Era. Later, we will travel to Aspendos where a most well preserved ancient theater is situated. After lunch we will have the chance to visit the museum optionally with no extra charge. Overnight Antalya.

14th Day: Transfer to Antalya airport. Fly home via Istanbul

en.title: Two Mary’s of Jesus Christ Tour
en.description: A unique tour of the House of Virgin Mary and Mary Magdalene Tomb
en.bodyHtml:
Itinerary

Your private Ephesus Tour Guide will welcome you at Kusadasi port or hotel.Then you will meet your private driver and get on a luxurious, A/C, comfortable veichle. After 30 minutes’ drive your spectacular day will begin. For a few hours you will feel like a Roman citizen living in the past in the ancient city of Ephesus. Your Ephesus Tour Guide will have the entrance tickets ready on the tour date. So you will skip the lines.Your Ephesus Tour will start at the upper gate and finish at the lower gate of Ancient Ephesus City.  You will have an extensive tour in this ancient site where you will see  Domitian’s, Trajan’s and Hadrian’s Temples, the huge Roman bath, Harbour Street, Marble Street, the Gates of Mihridates and Mazues, Commercial Agora, Latrina, the Scolastica Baths, Curetes Street, Polio Fountain, Memnius’ Monument, the Prytaneion, Odeon, the State Agora, the Celsus Library and the biggest amphitheater in Turkey. You will also visit the Virgin Mary's Chruch wish is one of the highlights of this tour.

We will drive to the mountain where The House of the Virgin Mary is located in a nature park between Ephesus and Selcuk. This is believed to be the last residence of the Virgin Mary, Mother of Jesus. This peaceful site is sacred to both Christians and Muslims, and is visited by many tourists and pilgrims. The House was later visited by Popes Paul VI and John Paul II, who confirmed its appropriateness as a place of pilgrimage. On November 29, 2006, Pope Benedict XVI celebrated mass here.

Leaving House of the Virgin Mary, In this special Itinerary you will also visit the tomb of Mary Magdalene in the ancient Seven Sleepers tomb. At the end of your Ephesus Tour,  your tour guide and driver will drop you back to Kusadasi Port.

fr.description: Une visite unique de la maison de la vierge Marieet du tombeau de Marie-Magdelene
fr.bodyHtml:
Itinéraire

Votre guide privé d'Ephése vous accueillera au port de Kusadasi ou au port d'İzmir.Ensuite,vous rencontrerez votre chauffeur privé et monterez dans un véhicule luxueux,climatisé et confortable.Aprés 30 mn de route ,votre journée spéctaculaire commencera.Pendant qq heures,vous vous sentirez comme un citoyen Romain vivant dans le passé dans l'ancienne ville d'Ephése,Votre guide aura les billets d'entrée préts a la date de la visite.Ainsi,vous éviterez les files d'attente.Votre visite d'Ephese commencera a la porte supérieure et se terminera a la porte inférieure de l'ancienneville d'Ephese.Vous aurez une visite approfondie de ce site antique ou vous verrez les temples de Domitien,Trajan et Hadrien,l'immense bain Romain,la rue du port,la rue de marbre,les portes de Mihridates et de Mazues,Agora commerciale,Latrina les bains Scolastica,la rue des curétes,la fontaine Polio,le monument de Memnius,le Prytanée,l'Odéon,L'Agora d'Etat,la bibliothéque de Celsus et le plus grand amphithéatre de Turquie.Vous visiterez également l'église de la Vierge Marie qui est l'un des points forts de cette tournée.

Nous vous dirigerons vers la montagne ou se trouve la maison de la Viérge Marie dans un parc naturel entre Ephése et Selcuk.On pense qu'il s'agit de la derniére résidence de la Vierge Marie,mére de Jésus.Ce site paisible est sacré pour les Chrétiens et Musulmans,et est visité par de nombreux touristes et pélerins.La maison a ensuite été visitée par les Papes Paul VI et Jean Paul II,qui ont confirmé son opportunité comme lieu de pélerinage.Le 29 novembre 2006,le Pape Benoit XVI a célébré la messe.

En quittant la maison de la vierge Marie,dans cet itinéraire spécial,voua visiterez également le tombeau de Marie-Madeleine dans l'ancien tombeau des Sept Dormant.A la fin de votre visite d'Ephese,votre guide et votre chauffeur vous raméneront au port de Kusadasi.

ru.title: Туры в Эфес из Кушадасы
ru.description: House of the Virgin Mary Basilica of St.John Temple of Artemis Туры по Эфесу с местными гидами
ru.bodyHtml:
Маршрут

Ваш личный гид по Эфесу встретит вас в порту Кушадасы. Затем вы встретитесь со своим личным водителем и сядете в роскошный, комфортабельный автомобиль с кондиционером. Через 30 минут для вас начнутся экскурсии по Эфесу из Кушадасы. Сначала вы посетите Дом Девы Марии. Мы отправимся на гору, где в природном парке между Эфесом и Сельчуком находится Дом Девы Марии. Считается, что это последнее место жительства Девы Марии, Матери Иисуса. Это мирное место является священным как для христиан, так и для мусульман и посещается многими туристами и паломниками. Позже этот дом посетили папы Павел VI и Иоанн Павел II, которые подтвердили его целесообразность в качестве места паломничества. 29 ноября 2006 года Папа Бенедикт XVI отслужил здесь мессу.

Далее вы посетите Древний город Эфес. На несколько часов вы почувствуете себя римским гражданином, живущим в прошлом в древнем городе Эфесе. У вашего гида по Эфесу будут готовы входные билеты в день экскурсии. Так что вы пропустите строки.Ваш тур по Эфесу начнется у верхних ворот и закончится у нижних ворот Древнего города Эфес.  У вас будет обширная экскурсия по этому древнему месту, где вы увидите Храмы Домициана, Траяна и Адриана, огромные римские бани, Харбор-стрит, Мраморную улицу, Ворота Михридата и Мазуеса, Торговую Агору, Латрину, Бани Сколастика, улицу Кюретес, Фонтан Полиомиелита, Памятник Мемнию, Пританеон, Одеон, Государственную Агору, Библиотеку Цельса и самый большой амфитеатр в Турции. 

Вы пообедаете традиционным турецким обедом в тихом и непринужденном ресторане недалеко от Эфеса. 

После обеда вы посетите базилику Святого Иоанна, которая была великой церковью в Эфесе, построенной императором Юстинианом в 6 веке. Он возвышается над тем, что считается местом захоронения святого Иоанна, который идентифицируется как Апостол, Евангелист (Автор Четвертого Евангелия) и Пророк (Автор Откровения). С холма, на котором была возведена базилика, вам откроется прекрасный панорамный вид на долину Эфеса.

Артемида была главной богиней Эфеса, и эфесяне построили самый большой древний храм, когда-либо посвященный ей.  Вы посетите руины Храма Артемиды (Артемидии), который был одним из Семи Чудес Света. После обеда ваш гид и водитель отвезут вас обратно в порт Кушадасы.

Посетите нашу страницу Туры по Эфесу, чтобы узнать о других вариантах тура

en.title: The list of Curetes
en.description: It is a list of the names of Curetes and Vestia Nuns who took a duty in Prytaneon. Curetes and the Vestal Virgins were in charge with the eternal flame, which was symbolizing the existence of the city. Vestal Virgins who were priestess and
en.bodyHtml:
It is a list of the names of Curetes and Vestia Nuns who took a duty in Prytaneon. Curetes and the Vestal Virgins were in charge with the eternal flame, which was symbolizing the existence of the city.

Vestal Virgins who were priestess and were named after goddess Hestia (or Vestia) who was in charge with Household and the flame. There are two re-erected Doric columns at the Prytanion. On each piece of marble there were the names of Curetes and Vestal Virgins who were in charge to keep eternal flame.

en.title: Trajan`s Fountain
en.description: It is the only monumental fountain in Ephesus, built for a Roman Emperor. It is located on the Curetes Street and built in the beginning of the 2nd Century. It is 9 and half meters tall with 2 storey. It was dedicated to Trajan the Roman Em
en.bodyHtml:
It is the only monumental fountain in Ephesus, built for a Roman Emperor. It is located on the Curetes Street and built in the beginning of the 2nd Century. It is 9 and half meters tall with 2 storey. It was dedicated to Trajan the Roman Emperor and Goddess Artemis.

In the Roman period Ephesians built a 39 km long aqueduct to supply water. This aqueduct arrived Ephesus were Trajan’s fountain was erected. Water was running into to the center of the pool where the huge statues of the emperors were situated. Today only feet of the statues are visible. The statue of Trajan was three times bigger than other statues, since he was a God. Other Statues found in the excavations are displayed in the Ephesus museum. The final restoration in Trajan’s Fountain made in 1958. There are main pool and smaller second pool. The drainage is visible and water was running into to central sewer.

en.title: Privacy Policy
en.description: 1.Overwiew; This Privacy & Personal Data Policy is meant to provide information on the personal data collected,retained,processed,shared and transferred by Magical Steps Tourism Ltd.Any person who visits www.magical-steps.com website,or use
en.bodyHtml:
1.Overwiew;

This Privacy & Personal Data Policy is meant to provide information on the personal data collected,retained,processed,shared and transferred by Magical Steps Tourism Ltd.Any person who visits www.magical-steps.com  website,or uses any service provided by Magical Steps Tourism Ltd.(e.g.makes a payment with his/her credit card to a merchant that receives payments via Magical-Steps.com)is covered by this Privacy &Personal Data Policy.When the term "Magical-Steps Travel" is used,it covers both Magical Steps Tourism Ltd as they share the same privacy principles and policy.Magical-Steps.com might be referred to as "we","us" or "our" in this policy.Legal titles and contact information of Magical-Steps.com companies can be found at the end of this document.

The terms "personal data","personal information" and "your information" are used interchangeably and they mean any information than can be associated to an identified or identifiable natural person(e.g.name,e-mail adress,birth date,national ID number).We are aware that personal data is important for our clients as well as end users and we endeavor within Magical-Steps Travel and that your personal data is kept safe.Purpose of this Privacy & Personal Data Policy is ;

To explain,in the most transparent and readable way possible,our ways and proposes of using the data we collect about you;                                                                                                              

To clarify the types of information we collect upon your permission and the purposes and methods for processing of them;

To inform you on the third parties we transfer this information to as well as our purpose and method in doing so;

To let you know your choices and legal rights with respect to your personal data;

To describe the extent of our responsibility for protection of your rights and privacy.

This Policy applies to products and services of Magical Steps Travel and Touristicom.com only.On websites and mediums that do not belong to Magical Steps Travel,the policies and rules of the respective person or organization.

The type of personal data processed by Magical Steps Travel depends on which services you benefit(some of them may be available according to your region and legal status) and how you benefit from them.

2.Personal Data Collected by Magical Steps Travel;

We collect different types of personal data about you when you visit our website or use our services.

When you visit our website,send a payment via Magical Steps Travel,we will collect information necessary to offer and fulfill your request in an efficient and secure way.This information may include:

Your contact details (e.g.your name,adress,e-mail adress,ID number)

Payment details (e.g. your credit card number,expiry date,instalment choice)

When someone sends funds to,or enters into any transaction that requires them to provide personal information about third persons,we collect personal data about those third persons.

İf you are a seller utilizing a platform (e.g. a marketplace) which uses our services,the platform may transfer your personal data such as contact details and bank account number.

Additional details you provide to us when you make use of services provided Magical Steps Travel or when you contact Magical Steps Travel (e.g. via the contact us form located on our website or e-mail).

3.Use of Personal Data by Magical Steps Travel and Legal Basis for Processing;

We use your personal data for various purposes permitted under data protection laws in Turkey,USA,European Union.Our purposes in using your personal data are explained with some examples below and are justified by lawfulness criteria stipulated in data protection regulations of USA,European Union and Turkey,such as performance of contractual obligations,our legimate interests,and legal obligations.

To operate our sites and provide our services,we need to use your information to initiate payments

To improve our services and manage our business needs,we monitor usage of our sites and services by you and analyze usage data to enhance our performance.

To mitigate and manage risk and protect our platform and customers from harm,we detect and prevent fraud by identifying customers and measuring their risk level.These decisions may be made by automatic algorithms as well human effort under set rules.İf you learn that a transaction you want to make has been rejected as result of those procedures,you may contact us at the contact information provided at the end of this document.

To contact you when needed,we may contact you regarding the status of your transaction.Also,when there is an issue related to your account or a payment you make,we may use your personal information to reach out to you so that we can resolve the issue.You may be contacted by Magical Steps Travel employees,or by employees of our business partners,in which case we need to share your personal data with those business partners.

To meet our legal obligations or resolve disputes,some regulations in the jurisdictions require us to use and retain your information in certain ways.As a travel services provider,we are obliged to keep and inspect records of all transactions we facilitate for various reasons including data retention,anti-moneylaundering and taxation.

When there is a legal dispute between Magical Steps Travel and you,or between parties of a transaction facilitated by Magical Steps Travel,your information may be used to resolve the dispute and presented to courts and other authorized dispute resolution authorities.We may also use your information in additional ways that you have consented to.For instance,we may seek your consent for sending you marketing material,receiving your feedback or other processing activities.İn those cases,you can always withdraw your consent by contacting us at the addresses provided at the end oh this Policy.You should include information that enable us to recognizeyou in that notification.Your notification of withdrawal of your consent will be effective in the future and therfore will not make our prior processing unlawful but it will make us cease to process that information from the receipt of your notification onwards.

4.Retainment and Erasure of Personal Data;

Magical Steps Travelretains your personal data in an identifiable format for the shotest period of time necessary to fulfil our legal obligations and for our business needs.When the period during which we retain your personal data ends,we will erase or anonymize your personal data so that they can o longer be associated with you,in line with our internal procedures that aim to ensure safety of your personal data.When you cancel your reservations or request erasure of your personal data,we will erase or anonymize parts of it that we are not legally obliged to reject your erasure request or to keep even if your reservation is canselled.

5.Transfer of Personal Data to Third Parties;

While providing our services,we sometimes share your personal information with third persons for purposes explained in this section.We share your personal data within Magical Steps Ltd-Touristicom.com group companies-cooperate partners (e.g.airlines,hotels,transportation companies,insurance companies etc.)in order to manage our operations and provide our services in a safe and consistent manner.The transfer between Magical Steps Travel and partners takes place with adequate safeguards in place,and your personal data does not fall outside the scope of this privacy policy because of this transfer.We utilize services of other companies as necessary and we may need to share your personal data with some of them.For example,when we receive your payment details we need to transfer them to respective financial institutions to initiate the payment.Or when the transaction you have made requires some additional steps to be taken (e.g.if it is an international purchase and customs procedures are to be completed) we may share your personal data with relevant service providers (e.g. customs brokers).We may also transfer personal data to third persons (e.g.anti-fraud processing companies)in order to ensure safety and convenience of our users and business.When you use our services,we notify the other parties to the transaction you have made,such as other users and merchants and other authorities may request information from us.We will share your information only when there is a legal obligation to do so;or when it is deemed necessary to prevent and/or prosecute a crime.We may also need to share personal data with third parties for other business purposes (e.g.for audits,corporate governance,or executing our legal rights).We will always comply with the law when doing so.

6.Choices Available to You;

You have choices available with respect to our privacy practices.You may always decline to provide personal data requested by Magical Steps Travel.However,if the information you have declined to provide is mandatory for provision of our services,you may not use our services.For instance,if you decline to enter your credit card number on the checkout form,we cannot initiate the payment.From time to time,we communicate with you.These communications may be for marketing purposes or notifications related to a transaction you have been a party to.You can opt-out of all marketing related communications by following the instructions at the end of messages we send.However,you cannot opt-out of transactional messages.

7.Your Rights;

We want you to know that you have following rights with respect to your personal data,as per the regulations governing use of personal data within EEA or Turkey;

a) To learn if we process your personal data,the types of data we process,souces we get your personal data from,third parties we transfer your personal data to within the country or internationally,the period for which we keep the personal data or how  we determine that period,

b) To access your personal data and to request the data provided by you to be given to you or another data controller in a structured,commonly used and machine readable format.

c) To learn the purposes for which your personal data is processed and to query if they are used in a compatible manner with those purposes,

d) To object to and request restriction of processing of your personal data,

e) To request rectification of innacurate and incomplete personal data about you.

f) To request erasure of your personal data when there is no legal basis for further processing,

g) To request notofication of procedures such as erasure and rectification to other third parties to whom your personal data has been transferred,

h) To object to any negative consequences arising from automatic analysis of your personal data,

i) To request indemnification for any damages arising from unlawful processing of your personal data.

You can exercise these rights by contacting us at the addresses provided at the end of this Policy.Your application should include the information you have given to us while registering or making use of our services as well as a photo ID,so that we may identify you.

8. Protection of Personal Data;

All personal data collected by Magical Steps Travel is transmitted and stored in compliance with reasonable security standards as adopted by the industry.The security of payment data is ensured with our PCI DSS Level 1 Comliant infractructure and all connections where personal data is transmitted are protected with encrytion.Even though we take all reasonable measures to protect your information,you are responsable for securing and maintaining your account information.

9. Miscellaneous;

Our services and websites are not directed to children,i.e. people who are not legal adults.We do not collect personal data from children or other individuals who are not legally able to use our services.İf we find out that we have collected Personal Data from a child,we will promptly delete it,unless we are legally obligated to retain such data.İf you believe that we have mistakenly or unintentionally collected information from a child,please contact us immediately at the addresses below.

We may make changes to this privacy policy in the future.Changes to the privacy will become effective on the date it is published to be effective.Magical Steps Travel obliged to follow any possible updates and inform their customers (or other users they make transactions with) on fintech company's data-processing activities (as well this privacy policy) before they transfer other persons' information to fintech company.

fr.title: Pourquoi nous choisir
fr.description: L'équipe de gestion, de réservation et d'exploitation de Magical Steps est composée de voyageurs et de guides professionnels. Nos guides sont des guides touristiques locaux professionnels et des experts en visites privées. Nous ne sommes pa
fr.bodyHtml: L'équipe de gestion, de réservation et d'exploitation de Magical Steps est composée de voyageurs et de guides professionnels.  Nos guides sont des guides touristiques locaux professionnels et des experts en visites privées.  Nous ne sommes pas seulement un agent local proposant des visites privées d'Ephèse, des visites d'Istanbul, des visites de Cappadoce et des visites combinées ;  nous organisons également des circuits, des allers-retours, des gestions de congrès, des circuits religieux et culturels dans toute la Turquie.  Sur notre site Web, vous verrez les brefs antécédents des personnes et des photos que vous contacterez de la part de l'entreprise et vous verrez les photos et les CV des guides touristiques qui vous guideront.  Nous choisissons nos guides avec soin pour vous offrir le meilleur service et la meilleure satisfaction.  Vous serez guidé par de nouveaux fourgons ou mini-bus Mercedes ou Volkswagen.  Pendant la visite, en cas d'urgence ou de besoin, vous aurez la possibilité de contacter directement l'équipe de direction via notre guide et vous aurez la possibilité de leur parler au téléphone.  Ou vous pouvez accéder à la réservation à partir des numéros directs inscrits sur votre document de réservation.

ru.title: Почему Вы Должны Выбрать Нас
ru.description: Команда по управлению, бронированию и эксплуатации волшебных шагов состоит из профессиональных путешественников и гидов. Наши гиды - профессиональные местные гиды и эксперты по частным турам. Мы являемся не только местным агентом, предостав
ru.bodyHtml: Команда по управлению, бронированию и эксплуатации волшебных шагов состоит из профессиональных путешественников и гидов. Наши гиды - профессиональные местные гиды и эксперты по частным турам. Мы являемся не только местным агентом, предоставляющим частные туры в Эфес, Туры в Стамбул, Туры в Каппадокию и комбинированные туры; мы также организуем туры, поездки туда и обратно, организацию конгрессов, религиозные и культурные туры по всей Турции. На нашем веб-сайте вы увидите краткие биографические данные людей и фотографии, с которыми вы свяжетесь в компании, а также фотографии и резюме гидов, которые будут вас сопровождать. Мы очень тщательно выбираем наших гидов, чтобы обеспечить вам лучший сервис и удовлетворение ваших потребностей. Вас будут сопровождать новые фургоны Mercedes или Volkswagen или мини-автобусы. Во время экскурсии в случае чрезвычайной ситуации или необходимости у вас будет возможность связаться с руководством напрямую через нашего гида, и у вас будет возможность поговорить с ними по телефону. nl.title: Tour Foto`s
nl.description: A warm welcome at Kusadasi Port! Your Ephesus tour guide will welcome you at Kusadasi port with a big smile on his face. He/She will be holding a sign with your name on it. At the end of your Ephesus tour, you will be dropped back to port o
nl.bodyHtml:
A warm welcome at Kusadasi Port!

Your Ephesus tour guide will welcome you at Kusadasi port with a big smile on his face. He/She will be holding a sign with your name on it. At the end of your Ephesus tour, you will be dropped back to port on time.

Visiting Basilica of St. John in Ephesus

In our Ephesus Tours you will have chance to visit the Basilica of St. John. It is believed that he lived in Ephesus for long years, died and buried here.

Private Istanbul Tours by one of our headguides Dundar

There is no doubt you will fall in love with magnificent Istanbul! Everyone with different interests will find something to enjoy in this beautiful city. If you have a great tour guide during your Istanbul tours, it will be a very special memory for you.

House of the Virgin Mary

The tradition is, visiting the House of the Virgin Mary first, then drinking the Holly spring water which runs out of the three fountains near the house and writing wishes on a paper and tying them on the wishing board.

Tours of Ephesus by local professional tour guides

You will enjoy your day in Ephesus and its surrounding with your private tour guide. You will be the only ones during your tour and your guide will be together with you throughout the tour.

Happy Ephesus Tours

Another wonderful moments that we share with our customers. Our tour guide Ugur has a great sense of humor and is very good at gathering history and fun.

Private Ephesus Tours for Couples

Is it your wedding anniversary or are you celebrating a special occasion or date? We will arrange the best tour for you to have such a magical day in Ephesus. You can expect a surprise from your tour guide any time!

A musician tour guide will make your day in Ephesus!

You will have magical and unforgettable moments with your tour guide Haluk! He is a professional tour guide and a musician at the same time. He enjoys playing his harmonica, especially in the grand theatre of Ephesus as if that he feels himself being a member musician in The Roman Ephesus Orchestra so that those who are guided by him will be entertained besides learning so much about the endless historical information about the way of life of the ancient civilizations.

en.title: Brothel
en.description: What it is used for is unknown but according to the common views it was a brothel. It was a large two-story building including a kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. There are some very beautiful mosaics on the walls of this building. This Bro
en.bodyHtml:
What it is used for is unknown but according to the common views it was a brothel. It was a large two-story building including a kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet.

There are some very beautiful mosaics on the walls of this building. This Brothel of Ephesus was facing the famous Celsus Library. First this was a holy place and Priapus god of love and fertile worshiped in here. His father is Dionysus and his mother Aphrodite. Later this place lost its religious character and became a brothel where slaves had to work.

ru.title: Отзывы о туре по Эфесу
ru.description: Great Day, Great Ephesus Tour! Today we had a tour of Ephesus. The driver was punctual and polite. The car was very clear. As we were 4 women travelling we felt very safe. The guide Atilla was most kind + informative. We enjoyed his company
ru.bodyHtml:
Great Day, Great Ephesus Tour!

Today we had a tour of Ephesus. The driver was punctual and polite. The car was very clear. As we were 4 women travelling we felt very safe. The guide Atilla was most kind + informative. We enjoyed his company immensely. We would highly recommend both driver and guide.

Wilma Mortimer
Australia

Great Istanbul Tour

This was a wonderful excursion. It was my favorite from my entire cruise. The driver did a great job and the guide Volkan was excellent, very personable and spoke perfect English. It was also very informative. I learned a lot about the Turkish culture as well as the wonderful sites we visited. The vehicle was great and the food was also. Thank you so much! I hope to return soon to take another wonderful tour with your company.

Debbie Couch
Jupiter – USA

We very much enjoyed both of our days in Turkey

ISTANBUL; Very much enjoyed our tour with Dundar in Istanbul. Since we had already visited Topkapi Palace, we were able to spend extra time at other sights. Dundar was extremely knowledgeable and took plenty of time to give us historical background. The van and driver was very nice and exceeded our expectation.

EPHESUS: We were fascinated by our visit to Ephesus. Our tour guide was able to get us into the terrace houses before the crowds arrived and helped us better understand the sights. Both he and the driver were very pleasant and professional. The lunch was delicious. We very much enjoyed both of our days in Turkey.

Michael Nifong
Atlanta – USA

Very excellent Ephesus Tour!

Very excellent tour. Levent is very knowledable and entertaining. He was able to answer all of our questions and enjoyale to listen to.

Kevin and Tina Hammond

I will turn first to Magical Steps!

In October 2010 I co-led a group of 18 people from four cities in the USA on a pilgrimage in Turkey to explore "Ancient Echoes for Modern Pilgrims." We traveled in four regions of this beautiful country, and visited the following cities during our tour: Şanlıurfa (Urfa), Antakya, Tarsus, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Izmir, Kuşadası, Ephesus, Pergamon, Bursa, Nicaea and Istanbul. All arrangements were made through the auspices of Magical Steps Travel located in Izmir ( http://www.magical-steps.com ). Although our budget was modest, the Magical Steps staff exceeded every expectation. Their approach is warmly personal, and they did everything they could to accommodate our wishes. We had the good fortune to work with two guides provided through this agency. Behlül Dündar Satılmış was an archeologist and Süleyman Tıraşoğlu was a teacher prior to becoming guides. Their knowledge of Turkey is deep and far-ranging. Their attitude was helpful and respectful. Their command of English is impecable. Ditto for the Magical Steps staff who took a personal interest in our group every step of the way.

Ours was a spiritual journey. Most of us are members of United Church of Christ congregations in America. We were interested in listening for women's voices from the early church and exploring the Wisdom tradition of Christian spirituality. In addition we wanted to know more about recent scholarship regarding Saint Paul. We wanted to engage in interfaith dialogue in this Muslim culture, visit UCC-related schools and ministries and interact with Turkish people in ordinary settings. A tall order for any agency! But Magical Steps more than accommodated us. We even managed to attend an engagement party and a bachelor's party!

I have led other groups in Turkey, Spain and Morocco. I have worked with other travel agencies. I believe the advice we received from Magical Steps was always appropriate to our concerns. We chose four-star hotels whever possible and these were mostly Turkish. They were modest but well-located, with excellent service, accommodations and food. Travel within Turkey whether by air or bus was always comfortable, and we learned a great deal about the history, agriculture, industry, customs and practices of the people.

I have already begun to plan my next trip to Turkey, and I will turn first to Magical Steps! If you have any questions about this review, please feel free to contact me.

Rev Dr Gilbert "Budd" Friend-Jones

I will turn first to Magical Steps!

In October 2010 I co-led a group of 18 people from four cities in the USA on a pilgrimage in Turkey to explore "Ancient Echoes for Modern Pilgrims." We traveled in four regions of this beautiful country, and visited the following cities during our tour: Şanlıurfa (Urfa), Antakya, Tarsus, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Izmir, Kuşadası, Ephesus, Pergamon, Bursa, Nicaea and Istanbul. All arrangements were made through the auspices of Magical Steps Travel located in Izmir ( http://www.magical-steps.com ). Although our budget was modest, the Magical Steps staff exceeded every expectation. Their approach is warmly personal, and they did everything they could to accommodate our wishes. We had the good fortune to work with two guides provided through this agency. Behlül Dündar Satılmış was an archeologist and Süleyman Tıraşoğlu was a teacher prior to becoming guides. Their knowledge of Turkey is deep and far-ranging. Their attitude was helpful and respectful. Their command of English is impecable. Ditto for the Magical Steps staff who took a personal interest in our group every step of the way.

Ours was a spiritual journey. Most of us are members of United Church of Christ congregations in America. We were interested in listening for women's voices from the early church and exploring the Wisdom tradition of Christian spirituality. In addition we wanted to know more about recent scholarship regarding Saint Paul. We wanted to engage in interfaith dialogue in this Muslim culture, visit UCC-related schools and ministries and interact with Turkish people in ordinary settings. A tall order for any agency! But Magical Steps more than accommodated us. We even managed to attend an engagement party and a bachelor's party!

I have led other groups in Turkey, Spain and Morocco. I have worked with other travel agencies. I believe the advice we received from Magical Steps was always appropriate to our concerns. We chose four-star hotels whever possible and these were mostly Turkish. They were modest but well-located, with excellent service, accommodations and food. Travel within Turkey whether by air or bus was always comfortable, and we learned a great deal about the history, agriculture, industry, customs and practices of the people.

I have already begun to plan my next trip to Turkey, and I will turn first to Magical Steps! If you have any questions about this review, please feel free to contact me.

Rev Dr Gilbert "Budd" Friend-Jones

I will turn first to Magical Steps!

In October 2010 I co-led a group of 18 people from four cities in the USA on a pilgrimage in Turkey to explore "Ancient Echoes for Modern Pilgrims." We traveled in four regions of this beautiful country, and visited the following cities during our tour: Şanlıurfa (Urfa), Antakya, Tarsus, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Izmir, Kuşadası, Ephesus, Pergamon, Bursa, Nicaea and Istanbul. All arrangements were made through the auspices of Magical Steps Travel located in Izmir ( http://www.magical-steps.com ). Although our budget was modest, the Magical Steps staff exceeded every expectation. Their approach is warmly personal, and they did everything they could to accommodate our wishes. We had the good fortune to work with two guides provided through this agency. Behlül Dündar Satılmış was an archeologist and Süleyman Tıraşoğlu was a teacher prior to becoming guides. Their knowledge of Turkey is deep and far-ranging. Their attitude was helpful and respectful. Their command of English is impecable. Ditto for the Magical Steps staff who took a personal interest in our group every step of the way.

Ours was a spiritual journey. Most of us are members of United Church of Christ congregations in America. We were interested in listening for women's voices from the early church and exploring the Wisdom tradition of Christian spirituality. In addition we wanted to know more about recent scholarship regarding Saint Paul. We wanted to engage in interfaith dialogue in this Muslim culture, visit UCC-related schools and ministries and interact with Turkish people in ordinary settings. A tall order for any agency! But Magical Steps more than accommodated us. We even managed to attend an engagement party and a bachelor's party!

I have led other groups in Turkey, Spain and Morocco. I have worked with other travel agencies. I believe the advice we received from Magical Steps was always appropriate to our concerns. We chose four-star hotels whever possible and these were mostly Turkish. They were modest but well-located, with excellent service, accommodations and food. Travel within Turkey whether by air or bus was always comfortable, and we learned a great deal about the history, agriculture, industry, customs and practices of the people.

I have already begun to plan my next trip to Turkey, and I will turn first to Magical Steps! If you have any questions about this review, please feel free to contact me.

Rev Dr Gilbert "Budd" Friend-Jones

I will turn first to Magical Steps!

In October 2010 I co-led a group of 18 people from four cities in the USA on a pilgrimage in Turkey to explore "Ancient Echoes for Modern Pilgrims." We traveled in four regions of this beautiful country, and visited the following cities during our tour: Şanlıurfa (Urfa), Antakya, Tarsus, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Izmir, Kuşadası, Ephesus, Pergamon, Bursa, Nicaea and Istanbul. All arrangements were made through the auspices of Magical Steps Travel located in Izmir ( http://www.magical-steps.com ). Although our budget was modest, the Magical Steps staff exceeded every expectation. Their approach is warmly personal, and they did everything they could to accommodate our wishes. We had the good fortune to work with two guides provided through this agency. Behlül Dündar Satılmış was an archeologist and Süleyman Tıraşoğlu was a teacher prior to becoming guides. Their knowledge of Turkey is deep and far-ranging. Their attitude was helpful and respectful. Their command of English is impecable. Ditto for the Magical Steps staff who took a personal interest in our group every step of the way.

Ours was a spiritual journey. Most of us are members of United Church of Christ congregations in America. We were interested in listening for women's voices from the early church and exploring the Wisdom tradition of Christian spirituality. In addition we wanted to know more about recent scholarship regarding Saint Paul. We wanted to engage in interfaith dialogue in this Muslim culture, visit UCC-related schools and ministries and interact with Turkish people in ordinary settings. A tall order for any agency! But Magical Steps more than accommodated us. We even managed to attend an engagement party and a bachelor's party!

I have led other groups in Turkey, Spain and Morocco. I have worked with other travel agencies. I believe the advice we received from Magical Steps was always appropriate to our concerns. We chose four-star hotels whever possible and these were mostly Turkish. They were modest but well-located, with excellent service, accommodations and food. Travel within Turkey whether by air or bus was always comfortable, and we learned a great deal about the history, agriculture, industry, customs and practices of the people.

I have already begun to plan my next trip to Turkey, and I will turn first to Magical Steps! If you have any questions about this review, please feel free to contact me.

Rev Dr Gilbert "Budd" Friend-Jones

In October 2010 I co-led a group of 18 people from four cities in the USA on a pilgrimage in Turkey to explore "Ancient Echoes for Modern Pilgrims." We traveled in four regions of this beautiful country, and visited the following cities during our tour: Şanlıurfa (Urfa), Antakya, Tarsus, Cappadocia, Kayseri, Izmir, Kuşadası, Ephesus, Pergamon, Bursa, Nicaea and Istanbul. All arrangements were made through the auspices of Magical Steps Travel located in Izmir ( http://www.magical-steps.com ). Although our budget was modest, the Magical Steps staff exceeded every expectation. Their approach is warmly personal, and they did everything they could to accommodate our wishes. We had the good fortune to work with two guides provided through this agency. Behlül Dündar Satılmış was an archeologist and Süleyman Tıraşoğlu was a teacher prior to becoming guides. Their knowledge of Turkey is deep and far-ranging. Their attitude was helpful and respectful. Their command of English is impecable. Ditto for the Magical Steps staff who took a personal interest in our group every step of the way.

Ours was a spiritual journey. Most of us are members of United Church of Christ congregations in America. We were interested in listening for women's voices from the early church and exploring the Wisdom tradition of Christian spirituality. In addition we wanted to know more about recent scholarship regarding Saint Paul. We wanted to engage in interfaith dialogue in this Muslim culture, visit UCC-related schools and ministries and interact with Turkish people in ordinary settings. A tall order for any agency! But Magical Steps more than accommodated us. We even managed to attend an engagement party and a bachelor's party!

I have led other groups in Turkey, Spain and Morocco. I have worked with other travel agencies. I believe the advice we received from Magical Steps was always appropriate to our concerns. We chose four-star hotels whever possible and these were mostly Turkish. They were modest but well-located, with excellent service, accommodations and food. Travel within Turkey whether by air or bus was always comfortable, and we learned a great deal about the history, agriculture, industry, customs and practices of the people.

I have already begun to plan my next trip to Turkey, and I will turn first to Magical Steps! If you have any questions about this review, please feel free to contact me.

ru.description: Ancient Ephesus, located in the Aegean Cost of Turkey, is one of the most attractive, big and old tourist destinations in the world. Ancient Ephesus is visited by a million of tourists every year. It was the capital of Romans in Asia Minor
ru.bodyHtml:
Ancient Ephesus, located in the Aegean Cost of Turkey, is one of the most attractive, big and old tourist destinations in the world. Ancient Ephesus is visited by a million of tourists every year. It was the capital of Romans in Asia Minor 2000 years ago. After the excavations it became a huge open air museum where the most important Roman works and art can be seen. There are two gates in Ephesus; upper gate and lower gate. There is a gentle slope, so Ephesus tours start at the top gate and finish at the lower gate. Ephesus is in 20 minutes driving distance to a famous touristic seaboard city called Kusadasi and about 1 hour drive to Izmir which is the 3rd biggest city of Turkey. It is possible to travel to Ephesus via highway, sea road and railway. You will find basic information in our Ephesus Map page that we prepared for you before you visit Ephesus on your own or take your Ephesus tour. All the places located in the 3 main streets of Ephesus included in our Ephesus Map. You can have more information by clicking on the short descriptions of each place. For more information please also visit our Ephesus Blog and Ephesus Tours pages

1. Harbor Street

It is one of the three main streets of Ephesus. Harbor Street starts from the theater and end at the harbor. It is 530meters long and there were shops and crosswalks on both sides. This street is also called “Arcadian” and it is about 11 meters wide. It was very close to the harbour and there was 'Four Columned Monument' at the end of the street.

Detail

2. The Great Theatre

It is the biggest ancient theater in Turkey with a capacity of 24.000 seats. It was built 4th Century BC. It took 60 years to build this huge Theater of Ephesus. It was a Greek Theater which had been converted into a Roman Theatre. There was a three storied stage building, erected in different times and paid by different Roman Emperor.

Detail

3. Commercial Agora

It is one of the two Agoras located in Ephesus with 11,000sqm of size. There were shops on 4 sides of the Agora. It was built on the Hellenistic period and enlarged on the Roman period. It was the biggest shopping area on that period. St Paul worked as a tent maker in the Commercial Agora with Priscilla and Aquila.

Detail

4. Library of Celsus

This gate is located next to the Celsus Library and opens to Agora. It was built by the slaves Mazeus and Mithridates 2000 year ago for Roman Emperor Augustus. Mazues and Mithridates were both architects.Then they became slaves of the imperial family of Augustus.

Detail

5. Gate of Mazeus and Mithridates

This gate is located next to the Celsus Library and opens to Agora. It was built by the slaves Mazeus and Mithridates 2000 year ago for Roman Emperor Augustus. Mazues and Mithridates were both architects.Then they became slaves of the imperial family of Augustus.

Detail

6. Marble Street

It is one of the main streets of Ephesus. It starts in front of Celsus Library, passes Theatre and reaches to the Temple of Artemis. The Library and the Agora are on the right side of the Marble street. Brothel is on the left side of the street. Further on the right there is the theater and further to its left there is a gymnasium. It also cuts the Port Street.

Detail

7. Brothel

What it is used for is unknown but according to the common views it was a brothel. It was a large two-story building including a kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet.

Detail

8. Hillside Houses ( Terrace Houses)

These luxurious Terrace houses used by the wealthy Ephesians between 1st Century AC to 7th Century AC. Terrace houses section 2 was covered in 1999 and protected. These magnificent houses, mosaics and frescos can be visited since 2002.

Detail

9. Public Toilets

These were the only public toilets in Ephesus and it is said that they were for man. Toilets are very well protected. There should be another public toilet for women in Ephesus which hasn't been found yet.

Detail

10. Latrina

These were the only public toilets in Ephesus and it is said that they were for man. Toilets are very well protected. There should be another public toilet for women in Ephesus which hasn't been found yet. There were 44 holes on the three sides of Ephesus.

Detail

11. Scholastica Baths

It was a beautiful Roman Bath complex located in the centrum along the Curetes Street, Ephesus. It was restored by a rich Christian woman named Scholastica after the earthquake in the 4th Century. There is a statue of Scholastica in the bath. Every room of the bath can be seen.

Detail

12. The Mosaic - Paved sidewalk

This was the area for the pedestrians which belongs to the 5th - 6th centuries. These mosaics are located in front of the Terrace Houses. At the Curetes Street which was one of the main streets of Ephesus, there were paths on the each side.

Detail

13. Entrance Scholastica Baths

It is the entrance road to the Scholastica Baths.

Detail

14. Hadrian's Temple

It is one of the Roman Emperor Temples. Hadrian the Emperor of Rome visited Ephesus twice. Such a beautiful Temple was built honor of him in the 2nd Century AD. Hadrian’s Temple is one of the best ruins in Ephesus and was restored recently. The Hadrian’s Temple was converted into a Christian church in the 4th Century AD.

Detail

15. Trajan's Fountain

It is the only monumental fountain in Ephesus, built for a Roman Emperor. It is located on the Curetes Street and built in the beginning of the 2nd Century. It is 9 and half meters tall with 2 storey. It was dedicated to Trajan the Roman Emperor and Goddess Artemis.

Detail

16. Curetes Street

It is the main street connecting upper Ephesus to the lower Ephesus. Its ancient name is Embolos. Herakles Gate, Terrace Houses, Hadrian Temple, Scholastica Baths and Hadrian's Gate are located on Curetes Street.

Detail

17. Hercules Gate

Hercules Gate is located at the beginning of Curetes street. Heracles' relics are visible on the two columns. It is a gate dividing the upper city of Ephesus. On this gate the frieze of Goddess Nicephorus (Roman Victoria) was situated.

Detail

18. Memmius Monument

It was dedicated to the famous general Memmius and his dictator grandfather Sulla. Memmius Monument was built in the 1st Century BC. Nowadays new excavations are showing that there were pipes very close to the monument and a side street nearby.

Detail

19. Temple of Domitian

It is the biggest Temple that was built in the city center. It was built for the Roman Emperor Domitian on the 3 floor podium. A huge head and left arm of a Domitian Monument is visible in the Ephesus Museum. The podium of the temple was huge and measured 100 meters by 50 meter.

Detail

20. An altar

It is a ruin of an altar located in Domitian Square. There are girlands symbolzing fertality, various fruit and bull head pictures on the altar.

Detail

21. The list of Curetes

It is a list of the names of Curetes and Vestia Nuns who took a duty in Prytaneon. Curetes and the Vestal Virgins were in charge with the eternal flame, which was symbolizing the existence of the city.

Detail

22. Freshwater pipes

In Roman time fresh water was supplied to Ephesus from 4 different points by the aquaducts. The water was delivered to the city by the clay pipes. Today these original pipes which are 2000 years old can be seen everywhere in Ephesus.

Detail

23. The Fountain of Pollio

It is one of the many monumental fountains in Ephesus. It was dedicated to the city by the rich Roman Pollios Sextiliues. This fountain was build and dedicated to Roman Emperor Domitian. It is just opposite the temple of Domitian.

Detail

24. Prytaneion

Prytaneon is the place where the holly fire was. The names of the monks and nuns who took a duty here in this place are written on the 2 columns. It was dedicated to the Goddess of Fire Hestia and was the holly center of the city.

Detail

25. Odeon

It is located on the upper Ephesus and built by Romans. The Odeon is well-preserved with a capacity of 1400 seats. It was used as a concert hall and parliament. This structure is about 2000 years old and was destroyed in the earthquake in the 7th Century AD.

Detail

26. Isis Temple

It is an Egyptian Temple located in the government agora. It was dedicated to the Egypt Goddess Isis. Later in Roman time, it was dedicated to the Roman Emperor Augustus. This was the first temple dedicated to an Egyptian goddess.

Detail

27. State Agora

It is the second agora in Ephesus. It is the government Agora. Political subjects were discussed here and it was open to public. Women and the slaves could attend the meetings here.

Detail

28. Baths of Varius

It was built by the rich Roman Varius for the Ephesians and located on the upper Ephesus. This bath was built in the 1st century AD and was destroyed in the 7th Century AD.

Detail

These were the only public toilets in Ephesus and it is said that they were for man. Toilets are very well protected. There should be another public toilet for women in Ephesus which hasn't been found yet. There were 44 holes on the three sides of Ephesus.

Detail

11. Scholastica Baths

It was a beautiful Roman Bath complex located in the centrum along the Curetes Street, Ephesus. It was restored by a rich Christian woman named Scholastica after the earthquake in the 4th Century. There is a statue of Scholastica in the bath. Every room of the bath can be seen.

Detail

12. The Mosaic - Paved sidewalk

This was the area for the pedestrians which belongs to the 5th - 6th centuries. These mosaics are located in front of the Terrace Houses. At the Curetes Street which was one of the main streets of Ephesus, there were paths on the each side.

Detail

13. Entrance Scholastica Baths

It is the entrance road to the Scholastica Baths.

Detail

14. Hadrian's Temple

It is one of the Roman Emperor Temples. Hadrian the Emperor of Rome visited Ephesus twice. Such a beautiful Temple was built honor of him in the 2nd Century AD. Hadrian’s Temple is one of the best ruins in Ephesus and was restored recently. The Hadrian’s Temple was converted into a Christian church in the 4th Century AD.

Detail

15. Trajan's Fountain

It is the only monumental fountain in Ephesus, built for a Roman Emperor. It is located on the Curetes Street and built in the beginning of the 2nd Century. It is 9 and half meters tall with 2 storey. It was dedicated to Trajan the Roman Emperor and Goddess Artemis.

Detail

16. Curetes Street

It is the main street connecting upper Ephesus to the lower Ephesus. Its ancient name is Embolos. Herakles Gate, Terrace Houses, Hadrian Temple, Scholastica Baths and Hadrian's Gate are located on Curetes Street.

Detail

17. Hercules Gate

Hercules Gate is located at the beginning of Curetes street. Heracles' relics are visible on the two columns. It is a gate dividing the upper city of Ephesus. On this gate the frieze of Goddess Nicephorus (Roman Victoria) was situated.

Detail

18. Memmius Monument

It was dedicated to the famous general Memmius and his dictator grandfather Sulla. Memmius Monument was built in the 1st Century BC. Nowadays new excavations are showing that there were pipes very close to the monument and a side street nearby.

Detail

19. Temple of Domitian

It is the biggest Temple that was built in the city center. It was built for the Roman Emperor Domitian on the 3 floor podium. A huge head and left arm of a Domitian Monument is visible in the Ephesus Museum. The podium of the temple was huge and measured 100 meters by 50 meter.

Detail

20. An altar

It is a ruin of an altar located in Domitian Square. There are girlands symbolzing fertality, various fruit and bull head pictures on the altar.

Detail

21. The list of Curetes

It is a list of the names of Curetes and Vestia Nuns who took a duty in Prytaneon. Curetes and the Vestal Virgins were in charge with the eternal flame, which was symbolizing the existence of the city.

Detail

22. Freshwater pipes

In Roman time fresh water was supplied to Ephesus from 4 different points by the aquaducts. The water was delivered to the city by the clay pipes. Today these original pipes which are 2000 years old can be seen everywhere in Ephesus.

Detail

23. The Fountain of Pollio

It is one of the many monumental fountains in Ephesus. It was dedicated to the city by the rich Roman Pollios Sextiliues. This fountain was build and dedicated to Roman Emperor Domitian. It is just opposite the temple of Domitian.

Detail

24. Prytaneion

Prytaneon is the place where the holly fire was. The names of the monks and nuns who took a duty here in this place are written on the 2 columns. It was dedicated to the Goddess of Fire Hestia and was the holly center of the city.

Detail

25. Odeon

It is located on the upper Ephesus and built by Romans. The Odeon is well-preserved with a capacity of 1400 seats. It was used as a concert hall and parliament. This structure is about 2000 years old and was destroyed in the earthquake in the 7th Century AD.

Detail

26. Isis Temple

It is an Egyptian Temple located in the government agora. It was dedicated to the Egypt Goddess Isis. Later in Roman time, it was dedicated to the Roman Emperor Augustus. This was the first temple dedicated to an Egyptian goddess.

Detail

27. State Agora

It is the second agora in Ephesus. It is the government Agora. Political subjects were discussed here and it was open to public. Women and the slaves could attend the meetings here.

Detail

28. Baths of Varius

It was built by the rich Roman Varius for the Ephesians and located on the upper Ephesus. This bath was built in the 1st century AD and was destroyed in the 7th Century AD.

Detail

There are two gates in Ephesus; upper gate and lower gate. There is a gentle slope, so Ephesus tours start at the top gate and finish at the lower gate. Ephesus is in 20 minutes driving distance to a famous touristic seaboard city called Kusadasi and about 1 hour drive to Izmir which is the 3rd biggest city of Turkey. It is possible to travel to Ephesus via highway, sea road and railway. It is one of the three main streets of Ephesus. Harbor Street starts from the theater and end at the harbor. It is 530meters long and there were shops and crosswalks on both sides. It is the biggest ancient theater in Turkey with a capacity of 24.000 seats. It was built 4th Century BC. It took 60 years to build this huge Theater of Ephesus. en.bodyHtml:
It is the main street connecting upper Ephesus to the lower Ephesus. Its ancient name is Embolos. Herakles Gate, Terrace Houses, Hadrian Temple, Scholastica Baths and Hadrian's Gate are located on Curetes Street.

There was a marble road in the middle for the vehicles, mosaic sidewalks and shops on the each side of the street. It ends at the Celsus Library. Behind the shops and stores there were famous Terrace houses on each side of the street. Curetes name was given by an archeologist. Curetes were noble and well known priests. On the Curetes Street there were basements where statues of Ephesian donators were situated. There is only one statues still staying there on a basement. It is the statue of Alexandros who was a doctor and died because of malaria.

tr.bodyHtml:

1993 yılında kurulmuş, Türkiye'nin Kuşadası'nda bulunan, Efes Turları, İstanbul Turları, Kapadokya Turları, Pamukkale Turları, Türkiye'nin her yerinde Kültürel, Dini ve özel turlar konusunda uzmanlaşmış lisanslı bir seyahat acentesiyiz.  Uzman bir tur acentesi olarak sizi Türkiye'nin mistik ve büyüleyici doğasını keşfetmeye davet ediyoruz.  Uygarlıkların kavşağı ve beşiği olan Küçük Asya, birçok tarih, kültür ve doğal güzellik sunar.  Sadece tarihi mirası değil, renkli ve cana yakın insanları da sizleri bekliyor.

Deneyimli ekibimiz, en iyi tur rehberlerini, konaklama ve ulaşımı almanızı sağlamak için bir araya geldi.  İlgi alanlarınıza, ihtiyaçlarınıza ve beklentilerinize göre kendiniz için en iyi turu seçme esnekliği sağlıyoruz.

Magical Steps Travel, küçük ve büyük grup turları düzenlemektedir.  Profesyonelce hazırlanmış grup turları size ülke ve insanlar hakkında çeşitli gezi seçenekleri sunar.

Kuşadası, İzmir limanı/Havalimanı/otel veya İstanbul'dan Efes Turları, TripAdvisor'da harika yorumları olan özel, profesyonel, deneyimli, lisanslı, yerel Efes tur rehberleri tarafından sağlanır.  TripAdvisor'daki incelemelerimizi okumak için tıklayın.  Giriş ücretleri, otopark, öğle yemeği, özel tur rehberi, özel transferler, benzin ve gaz dahil özel Efes turları düzenliyoruz.  Tur tarihinde sizden herhangi bir gizli ücret ve ekstra ücret alınmaz.  Ayrıca Kuşadası'ndan diğer turlarımıza ve İzmir'den turlarımıza göz atın

Limandan ve otelden İstanbul turları, lisanslı ve deneyimli özel İstanbul tur rehberleri tarafından düzenlenmektedir.  Tur rehberiniz tarafından İstanbul limanından veya otelden alınacak ve turun sonunda geri bırakılacaksınız.  İstanbul'daki zamanınıza ve ilgi alanlarınıza göre sizin için en iyi İstanbul güzergahını özelleştirebiliriz. İstanbul turları sayfamız için tıklayınız.

Ayrıca İstanbul'dan Kapadokya turları da sağlıyoruz.  3 günlük tur seçenekleri vardır ve Kapadokya'da Balon gezisi güzergahınıza eklenebilir.  Dilerseniz sizin için İstanbul'dan Kapadokya ve Efes turları da ayarlayabiliriz.

Добро пожаловать в мир путешествий "Magical Steps"!

Мы являемся лицензированным туристическим агентством, основанным в 1993 году, расположенным в Кушадасах, Турция, специализирующимся на Турах по Эфесу, Стамбулу, Каппадокии, Памуккале, Культурных, Религиозных и частных турах по всей Турции. Как опытный турагент, мы приглашаем вас исследовать мистическую и завораживающую природу Турции. Будучи перекрестком и колыбелью цивилизаций, Малая Азия предлагает множество исторических, культурных и природных красот. Вас ждет не только ее историческое наследие, но и колоритные и самые дружелюбные люди.
Наша опытная команда собралась вместе, чтобы обеспечить вам лучших гидов, проживание и транспорт. Мы предоставляем вам возможность гибко выбрать лучший тур для себя в соответствии с вашими интересами, потребностями и ожиданиями.

Компания Magical Steps Travel организует небольшие и большие групповые туры. Профессионально подготовленные групповые туры предоставят вам различные варианты осмотра достопримечательностей страны и людей.
Туры по Эфесу из Кушадасы, порта/аэропорта/отеля Измира или Стамбула предоставляются частными, профессиональными, опытными, лицензированными местными гидами по Эфесу, которые имеют отличные отзывы на TripAdvisor. Нажмите, чтобы прочитать наши отзывы на TripAdvisor. Мы организуем частные туры по Эфесу, включая входные билеты, парковку, обед, частного гида, частный трансфер, бензин и газ. В день тура с вас не взимается никаких скрытых платежей и дополнительных расходов. Также ознакомьтесь с другими нашими турами из Кушадасы и турами из Измира
